title: Governing by Doughnut? From political interest to the challenge of local implementation
affiliations: , , Rouen University,  and

detail.title: Governing by Doughnut? From political interest to the challenge of local implementation
detail.abstract: Conceived and developed by the economist Kate Raworth, the ‘Doughnut’ model has attracted increasing interest in recent years both in academic circles and among public and private actors at local level. According to its proponents, the Doughnut model, in challenging the economic growth paradigm, holds out a new vision of the economy and of economics attuned to the challenges of the 21st century.The aim of this article is to analyse the Doughnut framework’s appeal to local actors by examining the ways in which it is being implemented at local level. The research is based on a qualitative survey consisting of 16 semi-structured interviews with actors with direct links to the Doughnut model (researchers, political decision-makers, local public policy professionals) and on a review of the literature. We analyse the conceptual, organisational, operational and ethical obstacles encountered during the implementation of the Doughnut framework at local level. We show that Kate Raworth’s commitment combined with the dynamic of the Doughnut Economic Action Lab in promoting this multiform model explain the interest in adapting the Doughnut model to the local level in order to make it a tool of government. The Doughnut’s intrinsic characteristics also contribute to its appeal for local public actors. Analysis of the local applications of the Doughnut framework reveals tensions that are both conceptual – linked to the choice and quantification of normative indicators – and practical, due to limited resources and a weak link with actual socio-ecological changes.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了Kate Raworth提出的"甜甜圈"模型在地方层面的吸引力，通过定性调查揭示了该模型在实施过程中遇到的概念、组织、操作和伦理障碍，以及其作为治理工具的潜力与局限性。
AI.research_question: "甜甜圈"模型为何对地方行动者具有吸引力？在地方层面实施该模型时遇到哪些障碍？
AI.motivation: "甜甜圈"模型近年来在学术界和地方公共及私人行动者中日益受到关注，它挑战经济增长范式，为21世纪挑战提供了新的经济愿景。然而，其在地方层面的实施情况尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: Kate Raworth的"甜甜圈"经济学理论，挑战传统经济增长范式，强调在生态上限和社会下限之间实现平衡发展。
AI.method: 定性研究方法：包括16个与"甜甜圈"模型直接相关行动者（研究人员、政治决策者、地方公共政策专业人士）的半结构化访谈，以及文献综述。
AI.findings: 1. Kate Raworth的个人承诺和Doughnut Economic Action Lab的推动解释了该模型在地方层面的吸引力；2. 模型的内在特性使其适合作为地方治理工具；3. 实施中遇到概念性障碍（指标选择和量化）和实践性障碍（资源有限、与社会生态变化联系薄弱）。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对替代性经济模型在地方层面实施的理论理解，揭示了概念框架转化为实践治理工具时的张力，为后增长经济学的地方应用提供了实证分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政策制定者实施"甜甜圈"模型提供了实践指导，识别了实施障碍并提出了改进建议，有助于将该模型转化为有效的治理工具。

title: Factors Influencing to International Competativeness in Sri Lanka Apparel Industry
affiliations: General Sir John Kotelawala Defence University

detail.title: Factors Influencing to International Competativeness in Sri Lanka Apparel Industry
detail.abstract: Any Organization in Sri Lanka that wants to remain competitive needs to think about labor, infrastructure, sustainable manufacturing, and technology developments. One of the key elements that gives the Sri Lankan apparel industry an advantage over others has been discovered by these criteria. this study examines the key factor conditions, labor, infrastructure, sustainable manufacturing and technological advancement in Sri lanka's international competitiveness, with a specific focus on the apparel industry. A structured survey was conducted among the reputable manufacturing firms across the three provinces which are western province, Central province and East west province to assess how these factors contribute to international competitiveness. The research employed quantitative data analysis techniques, including parametric test to evaluate the relationship between the identified variable. The finding indicates that two independent variables demonstrated statistically significant positive correlation with the international competitiveness. With the technological innovation emerging as as the most influential factor in the Sri Lankan Apparel sector. These result emprises the critical role of the technology Driven advancement in maintaining enhancing Sri lanka's international competitiveness. The study contributes to existing literature by providing empirical insights and offering strategic recommendations for policymakers and industry leaders to strengthen Sri lanka's global economic position trough targeted improvements in factor conditions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨斯里兰卡服装业国际竞争力的关键要素，发现技术创新是最具影响力的因素，其次是可持续制造。研究通过定量分析验证了劳动、基础设施、可持续制造和技术进步对竞争力的影响。
AI.research_question: 斯里兰卡服装业的国际竞争力受哪些关键要素条件（劳动力、基础设施、可持续制造和技术进步）影响？这些因素如何影响其国际竞争力？
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡组织要保持竞争力需要关注劳动力、基础设施、可持续制造和技术发展。服装业作为斯里兰卡的优势产业，其国际竞争力对经济发展至关重要，需要识别关键影响因素以制定有效策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于波特钻石模型中的要素条件理论，研究劳动力、基础设施、可持续制造和技术进步四个关键要素对国际竞争力的影响机制。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，对西部省、中央省和东西省三个省份的知名制造企业进行结构化问卷调查，使用参数检验分析变量间关系。
AI.findings: 研究发现两个自变量（技术创新和可持续制造）与国际竞争力呈显著正相关，其中技术创新是斯里兰卡服装业最具影响力的因素。技术驱动的进步对维持和增强国际竞争力起关键作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为要素条件理论提供了实证支持，特别是在发展中国家服装业背景下验证了技术创新和可持续制造对国际竞争力的重要性，丰富了国际竞争力研究文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和行业领导者提供战略建议：应优先投资技术创新，加强可持续制造实践，通过有针对性的要素条件改进来增强斯里兰卡的全球经济地位。

title: The Past, Present, and Future of Polycentric Legal Order: A Comparative Institutional Analysis of Lex Mercatoria and Blockchain
affiliations: University of Pittsburgh - Graduate School of Public and International Affairs, University of Pittsburgh, GSPIA and University of Pittsburgh - School of Law

detail.title: The Past, Present, and Future of Polycentric Legal Order: A Comparative Institutional Analysis of Lex Mercatoria and Blockchain

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Institutional Economics, Volume 22, 2026, e2. doi:10.1017/S1744137425100386
U. of Pittsburgh Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-02
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Pittsburgh School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Medieval lex mercatoria refers to the customary commercial law developed by merchants to govern crossborder trade, operating alongside and sometimes independently of territorial legal systems. This paper compares that historical form of autonomous ordering with contemporary blockchain governance. Both create institutional frameworks that facilitate exchange among diverse actors and provide mechanisms that function, to varying degrees, outside traditional state authority. The key difference lies in how rules are generated and enforced: medieval merchant law relied on flexible norms interpreted by merchant courts and other human adjudicators, whereas blockchain systems seek to reduce ambiguity by encoding rules ex ante in smart contracts and automating enforcement. Decentralized decision-making and emerging forms of on-chain adjudication further reimagine dispute resolution without centralized judicial power. The central claim is that both represent polycentric legal orders whose significance ultimately depends on how they interact with, complement, or challenge formal governmental institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了中世纪商人法（lex mercatoria）与当代区块链治理，两者都是超越传统国家权威的多中心法律秩序，但规则生成和执行机制不同：商人法依赖商人法庭的灵活解释，区块链则通过智能合约事前编码和自动化执行。
AI.research_question: 中世纪商人法与当代区块链治理在构建超越国家权威的多中心法律秩序方面有何相似与不同？
AI.motivation: 探索历史上和当代两种超越传统国家权威的自治法律秩序，理解它们如何为跨国交易提供制度框架，并分析它们与正式政府机构的互动关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多中心法律秩序理论、自治治理理论、制度经济学、法律多元主义
AI.method: 历史比较分析法、制度比较分析、理论分析
AI.findings: 1. 两者都创建了促进多元参与者交换的制度框架；2. 关键差异在于规则生成和执行机制：商人法依赖灵活规范和人类裁决，区块链通过智能合约事前编码和自动化执行；3. 区块链的去中心化决策和链上裁决机制重新构想了无中央司法权力的争议解决；4. 两者都是多中心法律秩序，其重要性取决于与正式政府机构的互动关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将中世纪商人法与当代区块链治理置于统一的多中心法律秩序理论框架下分析；2. 揭示了自治法律秩序从依赖人类裁决到技术自动化执行的演变；3. 深化了对法律多元主义和自治治理理论的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为区块链治理设计提供历史借鉴；2. 帮助政策制定者理解新兴技术治理与传统法律体系的互动；3. 为跨国商业活动提供超越国家边界的制度框架设计思路。

detail.abstract: This short manuscript discusses the risks in implementing a compliance program, highlighting potentially elevated liabilities for a company from what data it collects and how it collects that data. The inappropriate use of compliance programs can foster distrust and disengagement, as well as become an affirmative part of driving widespread wrongdoing throughout a company. Additionally, companies that over-collect data on their workers, or who do not think carefully about why and how they collect data, face liability from prosecutors and others interested in the personal choices of workers. Finally, when under-invested in and treated as mere "check-the-box" initiatives, compliance programs expose their companies to significant liability by permitting leadership to turn a blind eye toward red flags.

AI.tldr: 该短篇论文讨论了实施合规计划的风险，指出公司可能因收集的数据内容和收集方式而面临更高的责任风险。不当使用合规计划可能滋生不信任和疏离，甚至成为推动公司内部广泛不当行为的积极因素。此外，过度收集员工数据或未审慎考虑数据收集目的和方式的公司，可能面临检察官和其他关注员工个人选择的相关方的责任追究。最后，当合规计划投入不足且被视为"走过场"时，会使公司面临重大责任风险，因为管理层可能对危险信号视而不见。
AI.research_question: 实施合规计划会带来哪些潜在风险和责任？不当的合规实践如何增加公司的法律责任？
AI.motivation: 虽然合规计划通常被视为降低法律风险的工具，但实践中存在许多不当实施的情况，这些情况反而会增加公司的责任风险。需要揭示合规计划实施中的潜在陷阱和反效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织合规理论、风险管理理论、代理理论、数据隐私与伦理理论
AI.method: 概念性分析/理论探讨，基于现有文献和实践观察进行论证性分析
AI.findings: 1. 合规计划可能成为增加公司责任的工具而非保护工具；2. 不当的数据收集实践会引发新的法律责任；3. "走过场"式的合规实施使管理层对危险信号视而不见；4. 合规计划可能滋生不信任和员工疏离；5. 过度监控员工可能引发隐私和伦理问题
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"合规计划风险悖论"概念，即旨在降低风险的合规措施可能反而增加风险；扩展了组织合规理论，强调实施质量而非仅仅存在合规计划；将数据伦理与合规风险管理相结合
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒企业合规计划实施中的潜在陷阱；2. 提供数据收集实践的具体指导；3. 强调合规计划需要实质性投入而非形式主义；4. 帮助管理者识别合规实施中的危险信号；5. 为合规官员提供风险防范策略

title: Cybersecurity Risk Management in IT Projects: A Systematic Review and Classification of Risks, Best Practices, and Framework Effectiveness (2020-2025)
affiliations: and University of Chester

detail.title: Cybersecurity Risk Management in IT Projects: A Systematic Review and Classification of Risks, Best Practices, and Framework Effectiveness (2020-2025)
detail.abstract: This comprehensive research synthesis examines cybersecurity risk management in IT projects through systematic analysis of 80+ academic and industry sources published 2020-2025, supplemented by detailed analysis of six major security incidents (SolarWinds, Colonial Pipeline, Capital One, Equifax, Meta, Tesla). The synthesis provides: (1) Complete risk classification covering technical, human, and organizational dimensions; (2) Comparative analysis of five major frameworks (NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, COBIT 2019, ISO 31000, UK CAF); (3) Evidence-based best practices across project lifecycles; (4) 100+ pages of actionable implementation guidance. Key findings demonstrate that existing frameworks, while valuable for enterprise governance, require substantial adaptation for IT project contexts. The synthesis reveals systematic gaps in agile methodology support, operational detail, and project-specific customization guidance. To address these operational gaps, this study performs a project-specific operationalization of Shimizu and Hashimoto's (2025) Vulnerability Management Chaining (VMC) framework, adapting evidence-based vulnerability prioritization (integrating CVSS severity, EPSS exploitation probability, and CISA KEV verified exploitation data) for resource-constrained agile IT projects. This adaptation resolves the resource-prioritization paralysis common in sprint-based development by embedding VMC within agile ceremonies rather than imposing external security checkpoints.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过系统分析80+学术与行业资料及6个重大安全事件，全面审视IT项目中的网络安全风险管理。研究发现现有框架需针对IT项目进行重大调整，并揭示了敏捷方法支持、操作细节和项目定制指导方面的系统性差距。研究通过将Shimizu和Hashimoto的VMC框架适应于资源受限的敏捷IT项目，解决了冲刺开发中的资源优先级瘫痪问题。
AI.research_question: 如何有效管理IT项目中的网络安全风险？现有风险管理框架在IT项目环境中存在哪些局限性？如何将漏洞管理框架适应于资源受限的敏捷IT项目？
AI.motivation: 现有网络安全风险管理框架主要针对企业治理层面设计，缺乏对IT项目特定环境的有效支持，特别是在敏捷开发、资源受限的项目环境中存在系统性差距，导致实际应用困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 网络安全风险管理理论；2. 漏洞管理链（VMC）框架；3. 敏捷开发理论；4. 风险分类理论（技术、人员、组织维度）；5. 主要风险管理框架（NIST CSF 2.0, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, COBIT 2019, ISO 31000, UK CAF）
AI.method: 1. 系统文献综述：分析80+学术与行业资料（2020-2025）；2. 案例研究：详细分析6个重大安全事件（SolarWinds, Colonial Pipeline等）；3. 框架比较分析：对比5个主要风险管理框架；4. 框架适应：将VMC框架适应于敏捷IT项目环境
AI.findings: 1. 现有框架对企业治理有价值，但需针对IT项目进行重大调整；2. 存在系统性差距：敏捷方法支持不足、操作细节缺乏、项目定制指导有限；3. 将VMC框架适应于敏捷IT项目能有效解决资源优先级瘫痪问题；4. 通过整合CVSS严重性、EPSS利用概率和CISA KEV数据实现基于证据的漏洞优先级排序
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了网络安全风险管理理论在IT项目环境中的应用；2. 发展了VMC框架在敏捷开发环境中的适应理论；3. 提出了项目特定风险管理的操作化理论；4. 丰富了风险分类理论在技术、人员和组织维度的整合
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供完整的风险分类体系；2. 提供100+页可操作实施指南；3. 提供基于证据的最佳实践；4. 提供VMC框架在敏捷项目中的具体实施方案；5. 解决冲刺开发中的资源优先级决策困境

title: PA-EWD: Privacy-Preserving Federated Analytics on Encrypted Wearable Data
affiliations: , Lecturer, Ton Duc Thang University, FPT University, FPT University, FPT University, FPT University and FPT University

detail.title: PA-EWD: Privacy-Preserving Federated Analytics on Encrypted Wearable Data
detail.abstract: The rapid response required during health crises like the COVID-19 pandemic underscores the critical need for real-time collaboration on data from wearable devices. However, aggregating such sensitive information across institutional boundaries faces a fundamental conflict: ensuring robust statistical utility while strictly maintaining patient privacy and data sovereignty. Existing solutions often struggle to balance these needs, either sacrificing privacy for speed or incurring prohibitive computational costs. This paper presents PA-EWD, a novel system that resolves this tension by integrating: (1) Edge-optimized Hierarchical Identity-Based Encryption (HIBE) for fine-grained access control; (2) Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) for aggregating statistics without decrypting raw data; (3) Adaptive Differential Privacy (DP) to guarantee output indistinguishability; and (4) An immutable blockchain ledger for query provenance. Evaluation on the LifeSnaps dataset demonstrates that PA-EWD achieves a query latency of approximately 1.5 milliseconds-a 55× speedup over homomorphic encryption baselines-while maintaining 99.7% utility (𝜀 = 1.0). These findings demonstrate that rigorous privacy and institutional autonomy can coexist with the high-throughput analytics required for modern healthcare.

AI.tldr: PA-EWD系统通过整合边缘优化的HIBE、安全多方计算、自适应差分隐私和区块链技术，在保护患者隐私和数据主权的同时，实现了穿戴设备数据的高效实时聚合分析，比同态加密基线快55倍。
AI.research_question: 如何在确保患者隐私和数据主权的前提下，实现跨机构穿戴设备数据的高效实时聚合分析？
AI.motivation: COVID-19等健康危机需要穿戴设备数据的实时协作分析，但跨机构聚合敏感数据面临统计效用与隐私保护的根本冲突，现有方案难以平衡这些需求。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 边缘优化的分层身份基加密（HIBE）用于细粒度访问控制
2. 安全多方计算（MPC）用于不解密原始数据的统计聚合
3. 自适应差分隐私（DP）保证输出不可区分性
4. 区块链不可变账本用于查询溯源
AI.method: 提出了PA-EWD系统，整合HIBE、MPC、差分隐私和区块链技术，在LifeSnaps数据集上进行评估，测量查询延迟和统计效用。
AI.findings: PA-EWD实现了约1.5毫秒的查询延迟，比同态加密基线快55倍，同时保持99.7%的统计效用（𝜀 = 1.0）。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了整合多种隐私保护技术的系统框架
2. 解决了统计效用与隐私保护的根本冲突
3. 证明了严格隐私与机构自治可以共存于高吞吐量分析
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为健康危机响应提供实时数据协作方案
2. 显著提升分析效率（55倍加速）
3. 保持高统计效用（99.7%）
4. 为穿戴设备数据共享提供可行技术路径

title: Equal Pay for Equal Work (for Equal Pay?)
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Brown University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Equal Pay for Equal Work (for Equal Pay?)
detail.abstract: When are the relative wages a firm pays to its workers "fair"? Theoretically, we characterize "Equal Pay for Equal Work" laws in the US as restricting wages to be monotonic in productivity at the individual level. Empirically, we study the pay and productivity of researchers at top public universities, where salaries and research output are largely observable. Is there is a weighting of output metrics (e.g. publications in one journal versus another) that rationalizes the wages within a firm as monotonic? We show that the answer is no in 61% of cases, and that inter-university moves by researchers contribute to violations of monotonicity. While individual-based Equal Pay for Equal Work is restrictive, we show that US-style laws nearly satisfy the desirable, symmetric fairness goal of "Equal Work for Equal Pay." By contrast, Equal Pay for Equal Work approaches in other countries which focus on group-level averages in pay controlling for output are less likely to symmetrically treat "pay" and "work."

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"同工同酬"法律的公平性，通过分析美国顶尖公立大学研究人员的工资与生产力数据，发现61%的情况下无法找到使工资与生产力单调对应的产出权重，表明个体层面的同工同酬法律具有限制性，但美国式法律几乎能满足"同酬同工"的对称公平目标。
AI.research_question: 企业支付给工人的相对工资何时是"公平"的？是否存在产出指标的权重分配，使得企业内部的工资与生产力呈单调关系？
AI.motivation: 研究"同工同酬"法律的公平性，探讨不同国家（特别是美国与其他国家）在实施同工同酬法律时的差异及其对公平目标的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将美国"同工同酬"法律理论化为限制工资必须在个体生产力层面呈单调性；引入"同酬同工"的对称公平概念。
AI.method: 实证研究美国顶尖公立大学研究人员的工资和科研产出数据，分析是否存在产出指标权重能使工资与生产力单调对应，并考察研究人员跨校流动对单调性违反的影响。
AI.findings: 61%的情况下无法找到使工资与生产力单调对应的产出权重；研究人员跨校流动导致单调性违反；美国式同工同酬法律几乎能满足"同酬同工"的对称公平目标，而其他国家基于群体平均的方法则难以对称处理"工资"和"工作"。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论化"同工同酬"法律为工资与生产力的单调性约束；提出"同酬同工"的对称公平概念；比较不同国家同工同酬法律方法的理论差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于同工同酬法律设计的实证依据；帮助组织理解工资公平性的实际限制；为大学和研究机构的薪酬管理提供参考。

title: Laying the Foundation for Progressive Development: A Critical Analysis of Atal Bihari Vajpayee's Infrastructure-Led Economic Vision and Its Enduring Relevance for India's "Vikasit Bharat" Agenda

detail.title: Laying the Foundation for Progressive Development: A Critical Analysis of Atal Bihari Vajpayee's Infrastructure-Led Economic Vision and Its Enduring Relevance for India's "Vikasit Bharat" Agenda
detail.abstract: In the centennial celebration of the birth of the Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee, this paper will analyse his unique economic vision and its underlying value to the current project on "Vikasit Bharat" (Developed India). Although the scholarship is split into individual areas of Vajpayee's economic legacy (infrastructure development, telecommunications reform, and education universalization), a critical gap in the scholarship lies in the inability to analyse these three initiatives as one systems-level developmental model. The paper holds the view that combining the National Highways Development Project (NHDP) and especially the Golden Quadrilateral (GQ), the Pradhan Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY), and the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) was integrated to form the infrastructure-cum-human capital development framework specifically created to bring about the physical, digital, and institutional hardware needed to make India a globally competitive, self-reliant economy. This paper, through a systematic reconstruction of the interrelationships between these three pillar initiatives based on a qualitative, descriptive-analytical methodology, founded on policy documents and secondary scholarly sources, will show how a systemic integration of these three pillar initiatives (national arterial highways coupled to small connecting rural roads, coupled with investment in universal elementary education and telecommunication liberalisation) was the basis around which the 21st-century economic path of India was developed. This paper concludes that this vision went far beyond being a compilation of projects and it was a consistent "Drishti" (developmental vision) that clearly foresaw and facilitated the current governmental desire of "Vikasit Bharat 2047". This legacy of Vajpayee is therefore more than historical retrospective; it is a blueprint of inclusive development based on infrastructure and an indication that long-term vision (executed by means of democratic processes and coalition politics) can indeed be successful in balancing immediate policies execution with decades-long goals of nation-building development.

AI.tldr: 本文分析瓦杰帕伊总理的经济愿景，认为其将国家高速公路发展项目、乡村道路计划和全民基础教育整合为一个系统性的基础设施与人力资本发展框架，为印度21世纪经济发展路径奠定了基础，并预示了当前"发达印度2047"愿景。
AI.research_question: 瓦杰帕伊总理的经济愿景如何将国家高速公路发展项目、乡村道路计划和全民基础教育这三个看似独立的倡议整合为一个系统性的发展模型，并为印度21世纪经济发展路径奠定基础？
AI.motivation: 在瓦杰帕伊诞辰百年之际，现有研究将其经济遗产分割为基础设施、电信改革和教育等独立领域，缺乏将这些倡议作为系统性发展模型的分析。本文旨在填补这一空白，揭示其经济愿景对当前"发达印度"项目的价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基础设施与人力资本协同发展理论、系统整合发展模型、长期愿景驱动的发展战略理论、民主进程与联盟政治下的政策执行理论。
AI.method: 采用定性描述分析方法，基于政策文件和二手学术资料，系统重建三个支柱倡议（国家高速公路、乡村道路、全民基础教育）之间的相互关系。
AI.findings: 瓦杰帕伊的经济愿景将国家动脉公路、乡村连接道路、全民基础教育投资和电信自由化系统整合，形成了基础设施与人力资本发展框架，为印度21世纪经济发展路径奠定了基础，并预示了"发达印度2047"愿景。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"发展愿景"（Drishti）理论框架，强调长期系统性整合在经济发展中的核心作用；发展了民主进程与联盟政治下平衡短期政策执行与长期国家建设目标的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前"发达印度"项目提供了历史蓝图；展示了如何通过基础设施与人力资本的系统整合实现包容性发展；为政策制定者提供了在民主体制下执行长期发展愿景的实践参考。

title: Inventory Recommendations in Platform-Operated Fulfillment Service: Trust and Information Asymmetry
affiliations: University of Michigan, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen (CUHK-Shenzhen) and University of Michigan, Stephen M. Ross School of Business

detail.title: Inventory Recommendations in Platform-Operated Fulfillment Service: Trust and Information Asymmetry
detail.abstract: Platform-operated fulfillment services are a cornerstone of modern e-commerce, yet their effectiveness is constrained by sellers' limited adoption of platform-generated inventory recommendations. This reluctance reflects misaligned incentives and limited trust, which prevent platforms from fully leveraging their informational advantage. We study how a platform should design inventory recommendations to balance short-run profit extraction with long-run trust formation and seller adoption. We develop a repeated newsvendor model in which a platform with superior demand information recommends order quantities, while the seller retains full control of ordering. Trust evolves endogenously based on the seller's perceived performance of past recommendations and governs future adoption. We characterize steady-state trust, adoption, and profits under two information regimes: full demand observability and demand censoring following stockouts. With full observability, the platform faces a fundamental trade-off: more aggressive recommendations raise profit when adopted but can erode trust, especially for inventory-conservative sellers reducing future adoption. Under demand censoring, sellers observe lost sales from understocking but cannot verify the potential overstock costs of larger orders during stockouts. This "masking effect" shifts trust formation toward the platform, enabling more aggressive (and more self-centered) recommendations while sustaining adoption. We show that in volatile environments with noisy demand signals, demand censoring can yield higher long-run platform profits than full transparency by strengthening trust and adoption. Numerical analyses confirm the robustness of these mechanisms, quantify the resulting coordination surplus and its allocation between the platform and the seller, and show that seller conservatism mitigates the masking effect and disciplines platform behavior.

AI.tldr: 平台库存推荐系统面临卖家采纳率低的挑战，因为激励不一致和信任缺失。研究平台如何在短期利润提取与长期信任建立之间平衡推荐策略，发现需求审查（stockout时需求不可观测）能增强信任，使平台能采用更激进的推荐策略，在波动环境中获得更高长期利润。
AI.research_question: 平台应如何设计库存推荐系统，以平衡短期利润提取与长期信任建立和卖家采纳？需求信息透明度（完全可观测 vs 需求审查）如何影响平台推荐策略、卖家信任和长期利润？
AI.motivation: 平台运营的履约服务是现代电商的核心，但平台生成的库存推荐采纳率有限。卖家不信任平台推荐，因为激励不一致，平台无法充分利用其信息优势。需要研究如何通过推荐设计建立信任，促进采纳。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重复报童模型：平台拥有优越需求信息，推荐订货量；卖家保留订货控制权。信任内生于卖家对过去推荐绩效的感知，并影响未来采纳。分析两种信息机制：完全需求可观测和缺货后的需求审查。
AI.method: 理论建模：建立重复报童模型，分析稳态信任、采纳和利润。数值分析：验证机制稳健性，量化协调剩余及其分配，分析卖家保守主义对平台行为的约束作用。
AI.findings: 1. 完全可观测下，平台面临权衡：激进的推荐提高采纳时的利润，但会侵蚀信任，特别是对库存保守的卖家。2. 需求审查下，卖家只能观测缺货损失，无法验证大订单的潜在过剩成本，这种"掩蔽效应"使信任形成偏向平台，允许更激进（更利己）的推荐同时维持采纳。3. 在需求信号嘈杂的波动环境中，需求审查能通过增强信任和采纳，获得比完全透明更高的长期平台利润。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将信任内生化到平台-卖家互动模型中，分析信任对推荐采纳的影响。2. 揭示需求信息透明度如何影响信任形成和平台策略选择。3. 提出"掩蔽效应"概念，解释需求审查如何改变信任动态。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台设计库存推荐系统提供策略指导：在波动环境中，适当的信息不透明可能更有利。2. 帮助卖家理解平台推荐策略背后的逻辑。3. 显示卖家保守主义能约束平台行为，平衡双方利益。

title: Does LLM Assistance Improve Healthcare Delivery? An Evaluation Using On-site Physicians and Laboratory Tests
affiliations: Yale School of Management, The George Washington University, , Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Harvard University

detail.title: Does LLM Assistance Improve Healthcare Delivery? An Evaluation Using On-site Physicians and Laboratory Tests

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Dr. Schwartz reports that a sibling of his is an employee of OpenAI. The sibling and the company played no role in the funding, design, execution, or writing of the research study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Approved by the Yale University IRB (protocol ID 2000035990) and the Kano State Health Research Ethics Committee (SHREC/2024/5464).
declarations.funderStatement: This research was funded by the Gates Foundation Grand Challenges Initiative (INV-081875) and a World Bank Research Support Budget grant. Dr. Schwartz received additional support from the University of Pennsylvania Matt Slap Research Award and the Department of Veterans Affairs Career Development Award initiative

detail.abstract:
We deployed large language model (LLM) decision support for health workers at two outpatient clinics in Nigeria. For each patient, health workers drafted care plans that were optionally revised after LLM feedback. We compared unassisted and assisted plans using blinded randomized assessments by on-site physicians who evaluated and treated the same patients, as well as results from laboratory tests for common conditions. Academic physicians performed blinded retrospective reviews of a subset of notes. In response to LLM feedback, health workers changed their prescribing for more than half of the patients and reported high satisfaction with the recommendations, and retrospective academic reviewers rated LLM-assisted plans more favorably. However, on-site physicians observed little to no improvement in diagnostic alignment or treatment decisions. Laboratory testing showed mixed effects of LLM-assistance, which removed negative tests for malaria but added them for urinary tract infection and anemia, with no significant increase in the detection rates for the tested conditions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 在尼日利亚两家门诊诊所部署LLM决策支持系统，帮助医护人员制定诊疗方案。虽然医护人员对LLM反馈满意度高且会据此修改处方，但现场医生观察到诊断和治疗决策改善有限，实验室检测结果也显示混合效应。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLM）决策支持系统能否改善尼日利亚门诊诊所的医疗决策质量？
AI.motivation: 在资源有限的医疗环境中，LLM可能提供有价值的决策支持，但需要实证评估其在真实临床环境中的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人工智能辅助决策、医疗决策支持系统、临床决策质量评估
AI.method: 在尼日利亚两家门诊诊所进行实地实验，医护人员为患者制定诊疗方案，可选接受LLM反馈后修订。采用盲法随机评估：现场医生评估相同患者，实验室检测常见病症，学术医生进行盲法回顾性审查。
AI.findings: 1. 超过一半患者因LLM反馈而修改处方；2. 医护人员对LLM推荐满意度高；3. 学术医生评价LLM辅助方案更优；4. 但现场医生观察到诊断一致性和治疗决策改善有限；5. 实验室检测显示混合效应：减少疟疾阴性检测但增加尿路感染和贫血阴性检测，未显著提高检测率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了LLM在真实临床环境中的实证证据；2. 揭示了主观满意度与客观临床效果之间的差距；3. 强调了AI辅助决策评估需要多维度指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为资源有限地区的AI医疗应用提供参考；2. 提示LLM决策支持需要更精细的临床验证；3. 为医疗AI系统设计提供改进方向。

title: Macroeconomic Impacts of Microeconomic Damages in General Equilibrium: Productivity and Capital Losses
affiliations: Resources for the Future and Department of Agricultural & Resource Economics

detail.title: Macroeconomic Impacts of Microeconomic Damages in General Equilibrium: Productivity and Capital Losses
detail.abstract:
The full economic costs and macroeconomic effects of microeconomic damages associated with pollution damages, climate impacts, and similar negative shocks are not well understood. Beyond the direct damages, market distortions, supply chains, changes in capital and labor costs, etc. can potentially magnify (or diminish) the costs of these shocks. In this paper, we use analytical and numerical general equilibrium models to investigate the channels through which microeconomic shocks affect the macroeconomy. We model different types of shocks, evaluate how anticipation affects the macroeconomic implications of shocks, and measure the overall welfare costs relative to the value of direct damages. We find that preexisting taxes magnify the overall welfare costs relative to direct damages, that savings and investment decisions driven by anticipations of certain types of shocks can interact with tax distortions to lower welfare costs, and that the ratio of welfare cost to direct damages varies substantially across sectors of the economy.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用一般均衡模型分析微观经济冲击（如污染损害、气候影响）如何通过市场扭曲、供应链等渠道影响宏观经济，发现既有税收会放大福利成本，而预期驱动的储蓄投资决策可能降低福利成本，且福利成本与直接损害的比例在不同经济部门差异显著。
AI.research_question: 微观经济冲击（如污染损害、气候影响）如何通过市场扭曲、供应链变化、资本和劳动力成本变化等渠道影响宏观经济？这些冲击的总体福利成本相对于直接损害的价值是多少？
AI.motivation: 污染损害、气候影响等负面冲击的全面经济成本和宏观经济效应尚未得到充分理解。除了直接损害外，市场扭曲、供应链中断、资本和劳动力成本变化等因素可能放大（或缩小）这些冲击的成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡理论，分析微观经济冲击通过市场机制传导至宏观经济的渠道，包括税收扭曲、预期形成、储蓄投资决策等理论框架。
AI.method: 使用解析和数值一般均衡模型，模拟不同类型的冲击，评估预期如何影响冲击的宏观经济含义，并测量总体福利成本相对于直接损害的价值。
AI.findings: 1. 既有税收会放大总体福利成本相对于直接损害的比例；2. 对某些类型冲击的预期驱动的储蓄和投资决策可能与税收扭曲相互作用，从而降低福利成本；3. 福利成本与直接损害的比例在不同经济部门之间存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了微观经济冲击通过市场渠道影响宏观经济的理论框架；2. 揭示了预期形成在冲击传导中的作用机制；3. 量化了税收扭曲对冲击成本放大的理论效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者评估环境政策的经济成本提供分析工具；2. 揭示了不同经济部门对冲击的敏感性差异，有助于针对性政策设计；3. 强调了考虑预期行为和税收扭曲在成本效益分析中的重要性。

title: The Edge of Prediction: From Stars to Systems – Part I/IV – Origins of Forecasting
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Edge of Prediction: From Stars to Systems – Part I/IV – Origins of Forecasting

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This conceptual and historical study does not involve human participants, patient data or experimental interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This paper explores how human societies have learned to anticipate the future and act under uncertainty, long before and far beyond contemporary AI and data-driven forecasting. It traces a historical arc from early cosmological interpretations and ritual practices to the emergence of mathematical models, statistical reasoning and complexity science.

Part I examines how early communities used observations of the sky, seasonal cycles and omens to structure uncertainty and coordinate collective action. With the invention of writing, observations could be recorded, compared and accumulated, turning fleeting events into historical data. Mathematics, probability theory and empirical science then transformed these records into formal models of the future and laid the foundations of modern forecasting.

The paper also analyses the epistemic and political dimensions of prediction systems. Mathematical models are treated not as neutral tools but as structured worldviews that shape which futures appear plausible, governable or “without alternative.” Finally, it discusses the limits of prediction in the face of chaos, nonlinearity and complex systems, where the future must be understood as a space of possibilities rather than a fixed point.

By connecting cultural history, mathematical development and systems thinking, the paper provides a conceptual framework for understanding today’s predictive infrastructures and prepares the ground for subsequent parts of the series on modern AI-based forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人类社会在当代AI和数据驱动预测出现之前，如何学会预测未来并在不确定性下行动。文章追溯了从早期宇宙学解释和仪式实践到数学模型、统计推理和复杂性科学出现的历史发展轨迹。
AI.research_question: 人类社会如何在不同历史时期发展出预测未来的方法，这些方法如何影响集体行动和决策，以及预测系统的认识论和政治维度是什么？
AI.motivation: 理解预测实践的历史演变，为理解当代AI预测基础设施提供概念框架，并探讨预测系统如何塑造我们对未来的认知和行动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合文化史、数学发展和系统思维，构建跨学科的理论框架，分析预测系统的认识论和政治维度。
AI.method: 历史分析方法，追溯从早期宇宙学解释、仪式实践到数学模型、统计推理和复杂性科学的发展轨迹。
AI.findings: 1. 早期社区通过天文观测、季节周期和预兆来构建不确定性和协调集体行动；2. 文字的发明使观测得以记录、比较和积累；3. 数学、概率论和实证科学将记录转化为正式的未来模型；4. 数学模型不是中性工具，而是塑造未来认知的结构化世界观；5. 面对混沌、非线性和复杂系统，预测存在局限性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了预测实践的历史演变框架；2. 揭示了预测系统的认识论和政治维度；3. 为理解当代预测基础设施建立了概念基础；4. 将文化史、数学发展和系统思维相结合。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助理解当代AI预测系统的历史根源；2. 为决策者提供预测局限性的认识；3. 促进对未来作为可能性空间而非固定点的理解；4. 为后续关于现代AI预测的研究奠定基础。

title: Nuclear Operations with a High Penetration of Renewables: The Case of France
affiliations: Paris School of Economics (PSE) and National Bureau of Economic Research (NBER)

detail.title: Nuclear Operations with a High Penetration of Renewables: The Case of France
detail.abstract:
Nuclear and intermittent renewables (wind and solar) are generally regarded as the only scalable technologies producing low-carbon electricity. However, the extent to which these technologies can co-exist in a reliable power system depends on whether nuclear units can adjust their operations to renewable output fluctuations. Using hourly data from the French power system, we find that nuclear units are operated quite flexibly, and that the foregone energy production due to “load following” actions (relative to the counterfactual of operating at full capacity during load following events) is currently limited. However, we find that an additional load following event is associated with a slightly higher likelihood of a unit failure. We also find that unit-level minimum output constraints are binding more frequently as system-wide renewable generation increases, especially so for units most exposed to solar generation. In 2024, hours during which available nuclear flexibility was exhausted are associated with non-positive hourly day-ahead prices.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用法国电力系统小时数据，发现核电站能够灵活运行以适应可再生能源波动，但额外的负荷跟踪事件会略微增加机组故障概率，且随着可再生能源增加，核电机组最低出力约束更频繁地成为限制因素。
AI.research_question: 核电机组能否灵活调整运行以适应可再生能源输出波动？这种灵活性对系统可靠性和市场价格有何影响？
AI.motivation: 核能和间歇性可再生能源（风能、太阳能）被认为是唯一可扩展的低碳发电技术，但它们在可靠电力系统中的共存程度取决于核电机组能否灵活调整运行以适应可再生能源输出波动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 电力系统灵活性理论、核电机组运行特性、可再生能源集成挑战、电力市场定价机制。
AI.method: 使用法国电力系统的小时数据进行分析，评估核电机组的负荷跟踪能力、故障概率与负荷跟踪事件的关系、最低出力约束的约束程度，以及这些因素对日前市场价格的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 核电机组运行相当灵活，负荷跟踪导致的能源损失有限；2. 额外的负荷跟踪事件与机组故障概率略微增加相关；3. 随着系统可再生能源发电增加，机组最低出力约束更频繁地成为限制因素，特别是受太阳能发电影响最大的机组；4. 2024年，核电机组灵活性耗尽的小时与零或负的日前市场价格相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 为核电机组灵活性提供了实证证据，揭示了负荷跟踪对机组可靠性的影响，阐明了可再生能源集成中核电机组运行约束的重要性，丰富了电力系统灵活性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电力系统规划者提供了核电机组灵活性的实际数据，帮助决策者评估核能与可再生能源的协同潜力，为电力市场设计和运行提供参考，特别是关于价格形成和系统可靠性管理。

title: Brexit and UK Migration: Germany-Benchmarked Evidence on Structural and Reallocation Shifts
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Eitan Berglas School of Economics

detail.title: Brexit and UK Migration: Germany-Benchmarked Evidence on Structural and Reallocation Shifts
detail.abstract:
This paper examines how Brexit reshaped the volume and composition of UK migration flows. To address the inherent endogeneity of migration responses to political change, the study employs a Difference-in-Differences design that benchmarks the United Kingdom against Germany, a stable EU member unaffected by Brexit-related institutional shocks. Treating the 2016 referendum and the 2021 end of free movement as sequential shocks, the results show that migration volume increased after both shocks, but through different channels: the referendum reduced emigration relative to Germany, while the post-2021 points-based system triggered a reallocation of inflows away from EU free-movement migrants toward non-EU migrants from the rest of the world, with a markedly stronger skill-selective profile. The paper analyzes how Brexit reshaped migration flows into and out of the United Kingdom by exploiting the 2016 referendum and the 2021 termination of free movement as sequential institutional shocks. Using a Difference-in-Differences design with Germany as a stable EU benchmark, the results show that Brexit acted as a structural regime shock, not a border-tightening event. Net migration into the UK rose after both shocks—first due to a sharp post-referendum decline in emigration relative to Germany, and later due to a substantial expansion of non-EU immigration under the new points-based system. Immigration patterns exhibit a clear regime shift, with EU inflows contracting sharply after 2016 and globally sourced, skill-selective inflows rising after 2021. In the later period, a modest but notable increase in UK-born emigration relative to Germany also emerges, reflecting frictions in post-Brexit mobility. Overall, Brexit reoriented—rather than reduced—UK migration flows, transforming both their scale and composition.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，英国脱欧并未减少移民总量，而是重塑了移民流动的规模和构成。脱欧公投后，相对于德国，英国移民流出减少；2021年自由流动终止后，欧盟移民流入减少，但非欧盟技能选择性移民流入增加，导致净移民总量上升。
AI.research_question: 英国脱欧如何重塑英国移民流动的规模和构成？
AI.motivation: 理解英国脱欧这一重大政治变革对移民流动的影响，特别是如何区分政治变革的内生性问题，以及脱欧是作为边境收紧事件还是结构性制度冲击。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度冲击理论、移民决策理论、双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences）作为因果推断框架
AI.method: 采用双重差分法（Difference-in-Differences），将英国作为处理组，德国作为对照组（稳定的欧盟成员国），将2016年公投和2021年自由流动终止作为序列制度冲击
AI.findings: 1. 脱欧公投后，相对于德国，英国移民流出显著减少；2. 2021年后，欧盟移民流入急剧收缩，非欧盟技能选择性移民流入大幅增加；3. 净移民总量在两次冲击后均上升；4. 后期出现英国本土出生者相对德国的适度流出增加；5. 脱欧是结构性制度冲击而非边境收紧事件
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了政治变革对移民流动影响的因果证据；2. 区分了制度冲击与边境收紧的不同效应；3. 展示了移民流动的重新定向而非简单减少；4. 强调了技能选择性移民政策的效果
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解脱欧后移民模式变化提供依据；2. 揭示了技能选择性移民政策的实际效果；3. 为其他国家移民政策改革提供参考；4. 帮助企业和劳动力市场适应移民构成变化

title: Global Stratification Economics (GSE): A Primer - Definitions and Research Implications
affiliations: City University of New York, Colorado State University, Fort Collins and Occidental College

detail.title: Global Stratification Economics (GSE): A Primer - Definitions and Research Implications
detail.abstract:
We coin the term Global Stratification Economics (GSE) to extend Stratification Economics (SE) to international contexts where mechanisms emerge that can be identified as (1) universal but matched to positioning along a country’s development path or (2) context-specific and historically dependent in ways different from the United States and other international environments. Building on SE’s core insight that groups compete over scarce resources and that dominant groups shape rules to preserve advantage, we define GSE as an approach that foregrounds historical genesis (e.g., settler colonialism, slavery, caste, extractive governance, military intervention), local institutions that structure dominance and resistance, and transnational mechanisms (e.g., imported stratification and the lateral mobility hypothesis) that link origin- and destination-country hierarchies. Drawing on evidence from Latin America and the Caribbean, Africa, South and Southeast Asia, and the global macroeconomy, we synthesize research on intergenerational mobility, wealth and asset inequality, labor-market segmentation, colorism, caste and ethnicity, gendered and intersectional constraints, spatial inequality and property regimes, and global value chains. We conclude by outlining how GSE reshapes measurement and international policy evaluation by centering group-differentiated outcomes, institutional transformation, and pillars of recognition, redistribution, and repair and by offering a checklist for researchers to apply GSE.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"全球分层经济学"(GSE)概念，将分层经济学扩展到国际背景，强调历史起源、地方制度和跨国机制如何塑造全球不平等。
AI.research_question: 如何将分层经济学(SE)的理论框架扩展到国际背景，以解释全球范围内的不平等和分层现象？
AI.motivation: 现有分层经济学主要关注美国等国内环境，缺乏适用于国际背景的理论框架来解释全球不平等机制，特别是发展中国家特有的历史依赖性和制度差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全球分层经济学(GSE)，基于分层经济学的核心观点：群体竞争稀缺资源，主导群体制定规则维持优势。强调历史起源(殖民、奴隶制、种姓制度等)、地方制度结构、跨国机制(进口分层、横向流动假说)。
AI.method: 文献综述和理论构建，综合拉丁美洲、加勒比、非洲、南亚和东南亚以及全球宏观经济的实证研究证据。
AI.findings: GSE框架能够解释跨代流动性、财富不平等、劳动力市场分割、肤色歧视、种姓制度、性别交叉约束、空间不平等、财产制度和全球价值链中的分层现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出全球分层经济学理论框架；2) 识别两种国际机制：普遍性机制和发展路径匹配机制、历史依赖性机制；3) 整合历史起源、地方制度和跨国机制三个分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 重塑国际政策评估的测量方法；2) 强调群体差异化结果和制度转型；3) 提供认可、再分配和修复三大政策支柱；4) 为研究者提供GSE应用检查清单。

title: The Impacts of Parole Supervision
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis, Washington University in St. Louis and University of Chicago

detail.title: The Impacts of Parole Supervision
detail.abstract:
We study the impacts of a reform to parole supervision in Illinois. The reform reduced the term of supervision for some parolees from 12 months to 6 months while many similar parolees continued to receive 12 months of supervision. We evaluate the impact of the reform using a standard difference-in-differences estimator, and we find clear evidence that the reform reduced prison re-entry rates. Sharp drops in rates of technical revocations drove these reductions. Rates of prison re-admissions linked to new crimes did not change. We merge data from Cook County Courts with our data on state prison admissions and releases, and we find no evidence that the reform increased crime rates among parolees. The reform reduced both the cost of incarceration and the cost of parolee supervision without creating harms to public safety.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 伊利诺伊州假释监督改革将部分假释犯的监督期从12个月缩短至6个月，研究发现这降低了监狱再入率（主要因技术违规减少），未增加犯罪率，同时降低了监禁和假释监督成本。
AI.research_question: 伊利诺伊州假释监督改革（将监督期从12个月缩短至6个月）对监狱再入率、犯罪率和成本有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究假释监督改革的效果，评估缩短监督期是否能在不危害公共安全的前提下降低再犯率和系统成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于刑事司法改革理论，特别是关于假释监督强度与再犯率关系的理论框架，以及成本效益分析框架。
AI.method: 使用双重差分法（difference-in-differences）评估改革效果，将改革组（监督期缩短至6个月）与对照组（仍为12个月）进行比较，并合并库克县法院数据和州监狱数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 改革显著降低了监狱再入率，主要原因是技术违规导致的撤销假释减少；与新的犯罪行为相关的监狱再入率没有变化；没有证据表明改革增加了假释犯的犯罪率；改革同时降低了监禁成本和假释监督成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为假释监督期限与再犯率关系提供了实证证据，挑战了"更长监督期更有效"的传统观念，支持了适度监督的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了缩短假释监督期可行性的证据，表明可以在不危害公共安全的前提下降低刑事司法系统成本，具有重要的政策实施价值。

title: Automation Experiments and Inequality
affiliations: Chapman University and Harvard University - Business School (HBS)

detail.title: Automation Experiments and Inequality
detail.abstract:
Many experiments study the productivity effects of automation technologies such as generative algorithms. A key test in these experiments relates to inequality: does the technology increase output more for high- or low-skill workers? However, the theoretical content of this empirical test has been unclear. Here, we formalize a theory that describes the experimental effect of automation technologies on worker-level output and, therefore, inequality. Worker-level output depends on a task-level production function, and workers are heterogeneous in their task-level skills. Workers perform a task themselves or delegate it to the automation technology. The inequality effect of improved automation depends on the interaction of two factors: (i) the correlation in task-level skills across workers, and (ii) workers' skills relative to the technology's effective skill. In many cases we study, the inequality effect is non-monotonic --- as technologies improve, inequality decreases then increases. The model and descriptive statistics of skill correlations generally suggest that the diversity of automation technologies will play an important role in the evolution of inequality.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个理论框架，解释自动化技术如何通过任务级生产函数和工人技能异质性影响工人产出和收入不平等。研究发现不平等效应取决于两个因素的交互作用：工人间任务级技能的相关性，以及工人技能相对于技术有效技能的相对水平。在许多情况下，不平等效应是非单调的——随着技术改进，不平等先减少后增加。
AI.research_question: 自动化技术如何影响不同技能水平工人的产出，进而影响收入不平等？
AI.motivation: 许多实验研究自动化技术（如生成算法）的生产率效应，其中一个关键测试涉及不平等问题：技术对高技能工人还是低技能工人的产出增加更多？然而，这一实证测试的理论内容尚不明确。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于任务级生产函数理论，工人具有异质的任务级技能。工人可以选择自己执行任务或将任务委托给自动化技术。不平等效应取决于两个因素的交互：(1)工人间任务级技能的相关性；(2)工人技能相对于技术有效技能的相对水平。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，通过形式化理论框架分析自动化技术对工人产出的影响机制，并结合技能相关性的描述性统计进行分析。
AI.findings: 自动化技术对不平等的影响是非单调的：随着技术改进，不平等先减少后增加。技能相关性的描述性统计表明，自动化技术的多样性将在不平等的演变中发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 为自动化技术对工人产出和不平等影响的实证测试提供了明确的理论基础，揭示了技能相关性和相对技能水平两个关键机制，并提出了非单调效应的重要理论洞见。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者和企业理解自动化技术如何影响劳动力市场不平等，为技术采用策略和劳动力政策提供理论指导，强调需要考虑自动化技术的多样性及其与工人技能结构的匹配。

title: State and Time-Dependent Pricing
affiliations: Bank of England, Stanford University - Department of Economics, Bank of England, King’s College London - King's Business School, University of Nottingham and Bank of England

detail.title: State and Time-Dependent Pricing
detail.abstract:
We present new evidence on how firms set prices using direct questions from a large, economy-wide survey of UK firms. Since 2023, 54% of firms report setting prices in a state-dependent manner, as opposed to changing prices at fixed intervals. In contrast, 44% of firms used state-dependent pricing in 2019. Smaller firms, those with a higher share of non-labour costs, and those reporting higher subjective uncertainty around sales and prices are more likely to be state-dependent. We then analyse the implications of price-setting behaviour for inflation dynamics. State-dependent firms experienced a sharper increase in price growth over 2022-2023, and also a faster subsequent decline. Using evidence from a randomised survey experiment, firm-level forecast errors, and local projections, we show that prices of state-dependent firms respond faster to cost shocks. The difference between state-dependent and time-dependent firms is furthermore larger for bigger shocks, consistent with theoretical predictions.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 基于英国企业调查数据，研究发现2023年54%的企业采用状态依赖定价（2019年为44%），这类企业对成本冲击反应更快，导致通胀波动更剧烈。
AI.research_question: 企业如何设定价格？状态依赖定价与时间依赖定价的差异如何影响通胀动态？
AI.motivation: 理解企业定价行为对货币政策传导和通胀管理至关重要，但现有研究缺乏大规模企业层面的直接证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 状态依赖定价理论 vs 时间依赖定价理论；企业定价行为的异质性；价格调整成本理论。
AI.method: 使用英国大规模企业调查数据；随机调查实验；企业层面预测误差分析；局部投影法。
AI.findings: 1) 2023年54%企业采用状态依赖定价（2019年44%）；2) 小企业、非劳动力成本占比高、主观不确定性高的企业更倾向状态依赖定价；3) 状态依赖定价企业在2022-2023年价格增长更快且后续下降更快；4) 这类企业对成本冲击反应更迅速，冲击越大差异越明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 为状态依赖定价理论提供大规模实证支持；揭示企业异质性对定价行为的影响；验证理论预测中冲击规模与定价行为的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助政策制定者更好预测通胀动态；为企业管理价格调整提供参考；为货币政策传导机制研究提供微观基础。

title: Weighing the Impacts of GLP-1s: Quasi-Experimental Evidence From Provider Adoption
affiliations: Duke University, Imperial College London and Duke University - Stanford School of Public Policy

detail.title: Weighing the Impacts of GLP-1s: Quasi-Experimental Evidence From Provider Adoption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Bock is a worker without compensation at the VA. Moshfegh was a postdoctoral fellow at the VA in 2024-25 and is currently a worker without compensation at the VA. Zhang is currently receiving VA salary support via intergovernmental personnel agreement and has previously received VA funding and salary support via graduate student fellowship and federal contracts.
declarations.funderStatement: This material is based upon work supported by the Department of Veterans Affairs Office of Academic Affiliations Advanced Fellowship, The Big Data Scientist Training Enhancement Program.

detail.abstract:
The arrival of GLP-1 medications has been described as one of the most important health care innovations in recent years. We provide large-scale quasi-experimental evidence on their real-world impacts by exploiting variation in the eventual prescribing propensities of patients’ pre-existing primary care providers. Using a panel intent-to-treat design, we compare outcomes for 1.4 million diabetic or obese veterans based on their 2018 provider’s eventual propensity to adopt GLP-1s, leveraging comprehensive electronic health records and biomarker data from the Veterans Health Administration, a setting with minimal insurance attrition and low-cost access to these drugs. Patients whose providers become higher propensity adopters experience substantial improvements in glycemic control and clinically meaningful weight loss; our treatment-on-the-treated estimates closely match estimates from clinical trials. Despite these metabolic benefits, we find no statistically significant effects on emergency department utilization, mental health and substance use outcomes, or non–GLP-1 medical spending through 2024.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用准实验设计，通过分析退伍军人健康管理局140万糖尿病或肥胖患者的医疗记录，发现医生处方GLP-1药物的倾向性对患者血糖控制和体重减轻有显著积极影响，但未改善急诊使用、心理健康或非GLP-1医疗支出。
AI.research_question: GLP-1药物在真实世界中对糖尿病和肥胖患者的代谢健康、医疗利用和医疗支出的实际影响是什么？
AI.motivation: GLP-1药物被认为是近年来最重要的医疗创新之一，但临床试验结果在真实世界中的效果和影响尚不明确，需要大规模实证证据来评估其实际效果和医疗系统影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于准实验设计和工具变量方法，利用医生处方倾向性的自然变异作为识别策略，评估医疗创新在真实世界中的因果效应。
AI.method: 采用面板意向治疗设计，分析退伍军人健康管理局140万糖尿病或肥胖患者的电子健康记录和生物标志物数据，利用医生2018年的GLP-1处方倾向性作为工具变量，进行因果推断分析。
AI.findings: 1) 医生GLP-1处方倾向性高的患者血糖控制显著改善，体重减轻达到临床意义水平；2) 治疗效果估计与临床试验结果高度一致；3) 尽管代谢指标改善，但急诊使用、心理健康、物质使用和非GLP-1医疗支出均无显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提供了GLP-1药物在真实世界中大规模准实验证据；2) 验证了临床试验结果在真实医疗环境中的可复制性；3) 揭示了医疗创新在改善特定健康指标的同时可能不改变整体医疗利用模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为医疗政策制定者提供GLP-1药物覆盖决策的实证依据；2) 帮助医疗系统管理者理解GLP-1药物对医疗资源利用的实际影响；3) 为临床医生提供真实世界疗效证据支持处方决策。

title: Effective Protection with Global Value Chains
affiliations: Dartmouth College - Tuck School of Business, University of Notre Dame and University of Notre Dame - Department of Economics

detail.title: Effective Protection with Global Value Chains
detail.abstract:
The effective rate of protection (ERP) is a widely-used tool to evaluate the joint impact of input and output tariffs on the net protection offered to individual sectors. Nonetheless, the theoretical foundations underlying the traditional ERP are decades out of date. In this paper, we provide fresh guidance for policy analysts that seek to measure effective protection, with two core elements. First, we develop a new ERP concept, which measures how much tariffs shift the derived demand for real value added at the sector level. The ERP then has an intuitive interpretation: it is the effective subsidy to buyers of sectoral value added that replicates the impact of the tariff structure on demand. Second, we demonstrate how to compute our ERP index accounting for global value chain linkages. The result is an ERP for the GVC age, in which effective protection depends on the structure of value chains across countries and sectors, and the structure of all tariffs applied globally. We demonstrate the usefulness of our approach by analyzing how recent tariff changes have altered effective protection in the United States and the rest of the world.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个适用于全球价值链时代的新有效保护率概念，该概念衡量关税如何影响部门层面的实际增加值需求，并展示了如何考虑全球价值链联系来计算该指数。
AI.research_question: 如何在全球价值链时代重新构建有效保护率（ERP）概念，以准确衡量关税结构对部门层面实际增加值需求的净保护效应？
AI.motivation: 传统有效保护率的理论基础已经过时数十年，无法适应全球价值链时代的需求。需要开发新的ERP概念来反映关税如何影响部门层面的实际增加值需求，并考虑全球价值链联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有效保护率理论、全球价值链理论、关税经济学、贸易保护理论。论文重新构建了ERP的理论基础，将其定义为衡量关税如何转移部门层面实际增加值需求的概念。
AI.method: 理论建模与实证计算相结合。首先开发新的ERP概念框架，然后展示如何在全球价值链联系下计算该指数，最后通过分析近期关税变化对美国及世界其他地区的有效保护影响来验证方法的实用性。
AI.findings: 提出了新的ERP概念，该概念具有直观解释：它是复制关税结构对需求影响的部门增加值购买者的有效补贴。在全球价值链时代，有效保护取决于各国各部门的价值链结构以及全球适用的所有关税结构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 更新了有效保护率的理论基础，使其适应全球价值链时代；2. 提出了新的ERP概念，衡量关税如何转移部门层面的实际增加值需求；3. 建立了考虑全球价值链联系的ERP计算框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策分析师提供了测量有效保护的新指导；2. 展示了如何计算考虑全球价值链联系的ERP指数；3. 通过分析近期关税变化对美国及世界其他地区的影响，验证了方法的实用性。

title: With or Without U? Binning Bias and the Causal Effects of Temperature Extremes
affiliations: Northwestern University, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: With or Without U? Binning Bias and the Causal Effects of Temperature Extremes
detail.abstract:
Estimates of climate impacts show that extreme temperatures have large and wide-spread effects. To estimate these effects, a common approach counts days in different temperature ranges and considers how exposure to these distinct 'bins' affects outcomes. This often produces non-linear, U-shaped results, in which high and low temperatures have the largest effects. We show that non-linear approaches like these can generate spurious findings. Specifically, global warming induces trends in extreme temperature exposure that correlate mechanically with a location's baseline temperature. Substantial bias emerges if trends in the outcome variable also correlate with baseline temperature for any reason. We demonstrate this problem theoretically, in simulations, and with real outcomes. We then develop solutions. In applications using US data, some results in the literature are unaffected by these corrections, while other results change substantially.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出，在估计极端温度对气候影响时，常用的非线性方法（如温度分箱法）可能产生虚假结果，因为全球变暖导致的极端温度趋势与基线温度存在机械相关性，如果结果变量的趋势也与基线温度相关，就会产生显著偏差。作者通过理论、模拟和实际数据证明了这一问题，并提出了解决方案。
AI.research_question: 常用的非线性温度影响估计方法（如温度分箱法）是否会产生虚假结果？如何解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 现有研究普遍使用非线性方法（如将温度划分为不同区间）来估计极端温度的影响，通常得到U形结果，即高温和低温都有最大影响。但这种方法可能存在系统性偏差，因为全球变暖导致的温度趋势与基线温度存在机械相关性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于计量经济学中的识别问题和偏差理论，特别是当解释变量（温度暴露）的趋势与基线特征（基线温度）相关时，如果结果变量的趋势也与这些基线特征相关，就会产生虚假的相关性。
AI.method: 1. 理论分析：证明非线性温度分箱方法可能产生偏差的机制；2. 模拟研究：通过模拟数据验证理论预测；3. 实证分析：使用美国实际数据检验现有文献中的结果是否受到这种偏差影响。
AI.findings: 1. 非线性温度分箱方法确实会产生虚假结果；2. 全球变暖导致的极端温度趋势与基线温度存在机械相关性；3. 如果结果变量的趋势也与基线温度相关，就会产生显著偏差；4. 在美国数据应用中，文献中的一些结果不受修正影响，而另一些结果则发生显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了非线性温度影响估计方法中的系统性偏差来源；2. 建立了理论框架来解释这种偏差的产生机制；3. 为气候经济学中的因果识别问题提供了新的理论见解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了解决这种偏差的方法；2. 为研究人员提供了修正现有估计的工具；3. 提高了气候影响估计的准确性，对政策制定有重要参考价值。

title: How Globalization Unravels: A Ricardian Model of Endogenous Trade Policy
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania - Department of Economics, International Monetary Fund (IMF) and Johns Hopkins University - Carey Business School

detail.title: How Globalization Unravels: A Ricardian Model of Endogenous Trade Policy
detail.abstract:
We study how uneven gains from globalization can endogenously generate protectionism as a political equilibrium. Using U.S. data, we document that regions more exposed to import competition display stronger opposition to globalization, especially among households with little financial wealth, and that firms in trade-exposed sectors sharply increase lobbying expenditures. To interpret these patterns, we develop and quantify a general equilibrium Ricardian model with heterogeneous households, input-output linkages, and endogenous trade policy shaped by voting and lobbying. Distributional shocks reallocate political support among voters, while lobbying propagates through production networks, generating strategic complementarities that sustain protectionism. Calibrated to U.S.-China sectoral data from 1991--2019, the model accounts for rising inequality, declining support for globalization, and key aggregate trends in consumption and trade.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨全球化收益分配不均如何内生地催生保护主义政治均衡。基于美国数据发现，受进口竞争影响较大的地区对全球化反对更强烈（尤其金融资产少的家庭），贸易暴露行业的企业游说支出大幅增加。通过构建包含异质性家庭、投入产出联系和内生贸易政策（投票与游说）的一般均衡李嘉图模型，揭示分配冲击改变选民政治支持，游说通过生产网络传播产生战略互补性，从而维持保护主义。模型校准至1991-2019年中美行业数据，解释了不平等加剧、全球化支持度下降及消费贸易的关键宏观趋势。
AI.research_question: 全球化收益分配不均如何内生地催生保护主义政治均衡？
AI.motivation: 全球化进程中收益分配不均导致政治反弹，需要理解这种保护主义倾向如何通过政治经济机制内生形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 一般均衡李嘉图模型，包含异质性家庭、投入产出联系、内生贸易政策（投票与游说决策）。
AI.method: 1. 实证分析：使用美国数据检验进口竞争暴露与全球化态度、游说支出的关系；2. 理论建模：构建包含异质性家庭、生产网络、投票和游说的政治经济模型；3. 量化分析：校准至1991-2019年中美行业数据。
AI.findings: 1. 进口竞争暴露地区更反对全球化（尤其金融资产少的家庭）；2. 贸易暴露行业企业游说支出大幅增加；3. 分配冲击改变选民政治支持，游说通过生产网络传播产生战略互补性，维持保护主义；4. 模型解释了不平等加剧、全球化支持度下降及消费贸易宏观趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将分配冲突、政治支持和游说纳入统一的一般均衡框架；2. 揭示生产网络中游说的战略互补性如何维持保护主义；3. 提供全球化政治反弹的内生解释机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 解释近年来保护主义抬头现象；2. 为政策制定者理解全球化政治经济后果提供分析框架；3. 揭示金融资产不平等在政治态度形成中的作用。

title: Price Discrimination with Costless Resale
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Price Discrimination with Costless Resale
detail.abstract:
This paper shows that income effects create an endogenous barrier to arbitrage, allowing price discrimination to survive costless resale. A monopolist sells an indivisible good to consumers with heterogeneous incomes who can freely resell. When the good is strictly normal, a consumer's reservation price to resell increases as the purchase price decreases—lower prices leave buyers wealthier and raise their valuation of the good. The monopolist exploits this by subsidising low-income consumers to raise their reservation prices to a target that high-income consumers must also pay. The optimal schedule increases dollar-for-dollar with income in the subsidised segment, weakly dominates uniform pricing, and achieves the first-best allocation when the entire market is served. We show the mechanism extends beyond income effects: low substitutability with market alternatives generates large reservation-price responses even when income sensitivity is modest. Sustaining discrimination requires market power at the individual level—consumer-specific quantity limits—not merely aggregate output restrictions. Extensions examine multiple monopolists and endogenous privacy choices.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 收入效应创造套利的内生障碍，使价格歧视在无成本转售下仍能存在。垄断者向异质收入消费者销售不可分商品，消费者可自由转售。当商品为正常品时，消费者转售保留价格随购买价格下降而上升——低价使买家更富有，提高其对商品的估值。垄断者通过补贴低收入消费者来提高其保留价格，使高收入消费者也必须支付该价格。
AI.research_question: 在消费者可以无成本转售的情况下，垄断者如何通过收入效应维持价格歧视？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为无成本转售会破坏价格歧视，但本文发现收入效应可以创造套利的内生障碍，使价格歧视在转售存在时仍能维持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于收入效应的价格歧视理论，消费者异质收入模型，正常品需求理论，套利障碍内生形成机制。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，构建垄断者向异质收入消费者销售不可分商品的模型，消费者可自由转售，分析收入效应如何影响转售保留价格和价格歧视均衡。
AI.findings: 1. 当商品为正常品时，消费者转售保留价格随购买价格下降而上升；2. 垄断者通过补贴低收入消费者来提高其保留价格，使高收入消费者也必须支付该价格；3. 最优定价方案在补贴段随收入线性增加；4. 该机制弱优于统一定价，当整个市场被服务时可实现最优配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别收入效应作为套利的内生障碍；2. 扩展价格歧视理论到可转售环境；3. 提出基于收入效应的歧视机制；4. 证明歧视需要个体层面的市场力量而非仅总量限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业在可转售市场实施价格歧视提供理论指导；2. 解释现实中价格歧视在转售存在时仍能维持的现象；3. 提供基于收入效应的歧视策略设计框架。

title: Banks, Financial Education and Digitalization in Highly Informal Economies: A Micro–Macro Model of Endogenous Screening

detail.title: Banks, Financial Education and Digitalization in Highly Informal Economies: A Micro–Macro Model of Endogenous Screening
detail.abstract: In many developing economies, informal firms account for a major share of employment and market activity, but remain largely excluded from bank credit. Classical models of credit rationing emphasize adverse selection and moral hazard, and focus on interest rates, collateral, or capital-intensive monitoring as ways to deal with imperfect information. However, a large fraction of informal firms are not intrinsically unprofitable: they mainly suffer from organizational deficits (no cash register, no bookkeeping, approximate inventory management) and a quasi-absence of data that can be exploited by banks and tax authorities. This paper proposes a micro-macro model in which a bank invests in a financial education and digitalisation program, denoted E, combining practical training, point-of-sale and payment tools, and a structured banking relationship. This investment reduces the adoption cost for high-potential firms, improves the traceability of their flows and generates a mechanism of endogenous screening: for a given effort level E, productive types adopt and become bankable, while subsistence activities self-select out. At the micro level, the adoption of E increases the survival probability and the customer lifetime value of large informal firms. At the macro-financial level, E reduces the preference for cash, raises the level and stability of deposits, lowers portfolio risk and increases the lending capacity of the banking system. We show that the bank's private optimum satisfies E >0 , but that the social optimum is higher (E soc > E) due to positive externalities on money creation, macro-financial stability and tax revenues, which justifies the intervention of public development banks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个微观-宏观模型，银行通过投资金融教育和数字化项目（E项目）来筛选高潜力非正规企业，改善其可追溯性，同时产生内生筛选机制。研究发现银行私人最优投资水平为正但低于社会最优水平，因此需要公共开发银行的干预。
AI.research_question: 银行如何通过金融教育和数字化项目（E项目）来解决非正规企业的信贷排斥问题？这种投资对微观企业生存和宏观金融稳定有何影响？私人最优投资水平与社会最优水平是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 在许多发展中经济体，非正规企业占就业和市场活动的主要份额，但被排除在银行信贷之外。这些企业并非本质上无利可图，而是主要存在组织缺陷（无收银机、无簿记、库存管理不精确）和缺乏可供银行和税务部门利用的数据。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 信贷配给经典模型（强调逆向选择和道德风险）
2. 内生筛选机制理论
3. 微观-宏观金融联动模型
4. 外部性理论（货币创造、宏观金融稳定、税收收入的正外部性）
AI.method: 构建微观-宏观理论模型，分析银行投资金融教育和数字化项目（E项目）的影响。E项目包括实践培训、销售点和支付工具、结构化银行关系。模型分析微观层面（企业生存概率、客户终身价值）和宏观金融层面（现金偏好、存款水平与稳定性、投资组合风险、银行系统贷款能力）的影响。
AI.findings:
1. E项目通过降低高潜力企业的采用成本、改善其资金流可追溯性，产生内生筛选机制：生产型企业采用并变得可银行化，而维持生计型企业自我淘汰
2. 微观层面：E项目采用提高了大型非正规企业的生存概率和客户终身价值
3. 宏观金融层面：E项目降低了现金偏好，提高了存款水平和稳定性，降低了投资组合风险，增加了银行系统的贷款能力
4. 银行私人最优投资水平E>0，但社会最优水平Esoc>E，存在正外部性
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一个整合金融教育和数字化的内生筛选模型，超越了传统信贷配给理论
2. 建立了微观企业行为与宏观金融稳定之间的理论联系
3. 识别了银行投资的正外部性，为公共干预提供了理论基础
4. 将组织缺陷而非固有盈利能力作为非正规企业信贷排斥的核心解释
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为银行设计金融教育和数字化项目提供了具体框架（实践培训、销售点工具、支付工具、结构化银行关系）
2. 为公共开发银行干预提供了理论依据，以弥补私人投资不足
3. 为发展中经济体解决非正规企业信贷排斥问题提供了可操作的政策建议
4. 展示了如何通过改善企业组织实践来增强金融包容性

title: The Economics of Scaling Early Childhood Programs: Lessons from The Chicago School
affiliations: University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Economics of Scaling Early Childhood Programs: Lessons from The Chicago School
detail.abstract:
Many ideas show remarkable returns in small-scale trials but often disappoint when scaled to broader populations and contexts. Using early childhood investment as a case study, this study develops a dynamic human capital formation model that integrates complementary skill investment with “Option C thinking” on scaling challenges. The model is stylized in the Chicago tradition: micro-founded with optimizing agents, dynamic skill production, and a policymaker evaluating scaling decisions. It formalizes how naive extrapolation from pilot studies systematically overestimates policy efficacy by ignoring “voltage drops,” declining treatment effects due to unrepresentativeness at scale. The model demonstrates that optimal scaling policy requires mechanism-based design that anticipates these failures through backward induction from implementation realities. The scientific insights from a set of recent studies provide valuable perspectives on the model.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个动态人力资本形成模型，解释了为什么许多政策在小规模试验中表现良好但在大规模推广时效果下降，提出了"电压下降"概念和"选项C思维"来解决规模化挑战。
AI.research_question: 为什么许多政策在小规模试验中表现出色但在大规模推广时效果下降？如何通过机制设计来优化政策规模化决策？
AI.motivation: 许多政策在小规模试点中显示显著回报，但在推广到更广泛人群和情境时效果不佳，这种"规模化失望"现象需要理论解释和解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态人力资本形成模型，结合互补性技能投资和"选项C思维"（从实施现实出发的反向归纳思维），芝加哥学派传统：微观基础、优化代理人、动态技能生产。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建动态人力资本形成模型，形式化分析政策规模化过程中的"电压下降"现象，使用反向归纳法从实施现实出发进行机制设计。
AI.findings: 天真的试点结果外推会系统性地高估政策效果，因为忽略了"电压下降"（由于规模扩大时样本不代表性导致的处理效应下降）。最优规模化政策需要基于机制的、从实施现实出发的反向设计。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了政策规模化挑战的理论框架，提出了"电压下降"概念，发展了"选项C思维"作为解决规模化问题的理论方法，扩展了人力资本形成理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估政策规模化的分析框架，强调从实施现实出发的机制设计，避免基于试点结果的盲目外推，提高政策推广的成功率。

title: Experiences, Expectations, and Asset Prices
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Experiences, Expectations, and Asset Prices
detail.abstract:
In models with subjective beliefs, the dynamics of investor beliefs are central to explaining asset price movements. Allowing subjective beliefs to deviate from full-information rational expectations requires a model of how investors form beliefs. I review recent research that explores experience-based belief formation. The experience-based model closely resembles Bayesian updating but allows individuals to overweight data observed during their own lifetimes when forming beliefs about the parameters of the data-generating process. Because individuals of different age learn from different histories, the model predicts heterogeneity between age groups that evolves over time with the path of realized data individuals have experienced, closely mirroring the age-related variation observed in survey microdata. At the aggregate level, experience-based expectations formation can explain asset price dynamics. In the stock market, learning from experience about long-run cash flow growth generates valuation cycles and return predictability. Experience-based formation of long-term inflation expectations can explain secular changes of real interest rates. I conclude by outlining directions for future research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了基于经验的信念形成模型在资产定价中的应用。该模型假设投资者在形成对数据生成过程参数的信念时，会过度重视自己生命周期内观察到的数据，导致不同年龄群体的信念异质性，从而解释资产价格动态。
AI.research_question: 基于经验的信念形成如何解释资产价格动态和投资者信念异质性？
AI.motivation: 在主观信念模型中，投资者信念动态对解释资产价格变动至关重要。需要建立投资者如何形成信念的模型，特别是当信念偏离完全信息理性预期时。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经验的信念形成模型，类似于贝叶斯更新但允许个体过度重视自己生命周期内观察到的数据，形成对数据生成过程参数的信念。
AI.method: 文献综述方法，回顾近期关于经验基础信念形成的研究，分析其在资产定价中的应用。
AI.findings: 1) 不同年龄个体从不同历史数据中学习，导致年龄群体间的信念异质性随时间演变；2) 股票市场中基于长期现金流增长的经验学习能解释估值周期和收益可预测性；3) 长期通胀预期的经验形成能解释实际利率的长期变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于经验的信念形成理论框架，将投资者生命周期经历纳入信念形成过程，为解释信念异质性和资产价格动态提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解资产价格动态、投资者行为异质性和市场波动提供了实践指导，有助于政策制定者理解信念形成机制对金融市场的影响。

title: Corporate Intent
affiliations: HEC, University of Pennsylvania and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Sloan School of Management

detail.title: Corporate Intent
detail.abstract:
Do investors care about why a firm behaves responsibly, over and above what the firm does and how much cash it earns? In our main experiment, participants value shares in companies that reduce pollution relative to peers, while CEOs articulate the company’s intentions: prosocial or for-profit. Investors are willing to pay more for shares in a company that takes a given prosocial action if it is motivated by social concern rather than profit maximization. This "intention premium" is distinct from the valuation effects of cash flows and environmental externalities. Respondents who are deontological, politically liberal, female, or less individualistic value the company’s intent the most. Additionally, and somewhat surprisingly, respondents view favorably firms that embrace both profit and social objectives, without ranking them. Overall, our findings temper claims that when there is no financial trade-off between doing good and doing well, shareholder value and stakeholder value maximization are equivalent.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 投资者不仅关心企业做了什么和赚了多少钱，还关心企业为何要负责任地行事。研究发现，当企业出于社会关怀而非利润最大化动机采取相同的环保行动时，投资者愿意支付更高的股价，这种"意图溢价"独立于现金流和环境外部性的估值效应。
AI.research_question: 投资者是否关心企业负责任行为的动机（为什么这样做），而不仅仅是企业做了什么和赚了多少钱？
AI.motivation: 探讨在无财务权衡的情况下，股东价值最大化与利益相关者价值最大化是否真的等同，以及企业意图在投资者估值中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合行为金融学、企业社会责任理论、投资者心理学和道德哲学（道义论）框架，分析投资者对企业意图的评估机制。
AI.method: 主要采用实验方法，参与者对减少污染的公司股票进行估值，同时CEO表达公司意图（社会关怀导向vs利润最大化导向）。
AI.findings: 1. 投资者愿意为出于社会关怀动机的公司支付更高股价（"意图溢价"）；2. 该溢价独立于现金流和环境外部性；3. 道义论者、政治自由派、女性和较少个人主义的受访者最重视企业意图；4. 投资者对同时追求利润和社会目标的企业持积极态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别并量化了"意图溢价"现象；2. 挑战了"无财务权衡时股东与利益相关者价值最大化等同"的观点；3. 将道德哲学（道义论）引入投资者行为分析；4. 揭示了企业意图在估值中的独立作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业沟通社会责任动机提供指导；2. 帮助投资者理解自身估值偏好；3. 为管理者平衡利润与社会目标提供实证依据；4. 对ESG投资策略有重要启示。

title: The Impact of Preschool Entry Age on Children’s Behavioral and Developmental Health in Medicaid
affiliations: Stanford University, Stanford University and University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: The Impact of Preschool Entry Age on Children’s Behavioral and Developmental Health in Medicaid

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study has been approved by Stanford's Institutional Review Board (Protocol 68281).
declarations.funderStatement: Grant support from the Eunice Kennedy Shriver National Institute of Child Health and Human Development (K01-HD113828-01A1) and the Yvette Gurley Research Scholar Fund.

detail.abstract: We find that preschools facilitate early diagnosis and treatment of conditions that can hinder learning. Low-income children born shortly before their state's school-entry cutoff date are 16.9, 9.3, and 14.8 percent more likely to be diagnosed with Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder, a speech or language disorder, and a hearing or vision condition at ages three and four, compared to children born after the cutoff. They are also more likely to receive downstream services. Findings emphasize the role of earlier and longer exposure to public preschool in driving diagnostic gaps previously attributed to elementary school-entry and within-grade peer comparisons.

AI.tldr: 研究发现学前教育有助于早期诊断和治疗可能影响学习的疾病。低收入家庭中，出生日期刚好在州入学截止日期前的儿童，在3-4岁时被诊断出注意力缺陷多动障碍、言语/语言障碍、听力/视力问题的概率分别高出16.9%、9.3%和14.8%，并且更可能获得后续服务。
AI.research_question: 学前教育如何影响儿童早期健康问题的诊断和治疗？特别是低收入家庭中，出生日期接近入学截止日期的儿童在诊断率方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: 先前研究主要关注小学入学和同年级同伴比较对诊断差异的影响，但忽视了学前教育的作用。本研究旨在探讨更早、更长时间的公立学前教育如何影响儿童早期健康问题的诊断和治疗。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 入学截止日期效应：基于州入学截止日期的准自然实验设计
2. 学前教育暴露理论：更早、更长时间的学前教育增加了教师观察和识别问题的机会
3. 医疗资源获取理论：学前教育作为连接低收入家庭与医疗服务的桥梁
AI.method: 采用准自然实验设计，利用州入学截止日期作为工具变量。比较出生日期刚好在截止日期前（较早入学）和截止日期后（较晚入学）的低收入儿童在3-4岁时的诊断率和服务获取情况。
AI.findings:
1. 低收入儿童中，出生在入学截止日期前的儿童在3-4岁时被诊断出ADHD的概率高出16.9%
2. 言语/语言障碍诊断率高出9.3%
3. 听力/视力问题诊断率高出14.8%
4. 这些儿童也更可能获得后续治疗服务
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 挑战了先前将诊断差异主要归因于小学入学和同年级同伴比较的理论
2. 提出了学前教育暴露作为早期诊断的重要机制
3. 为入学截止日期效应提供了新的解释框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 强调了学前教育在早期识别儿童健康问题中的重要作用
2. 为政策制定者提供了扩大低收入家庭学前教育覆盖的依据
3. 有助于设计更有效的早期干预和转诊系统
4. 对入学截止日期政策的健康影响评估提供了新视角

title: Transformed Intermediation:  Credit Risk to NBFIs, Liquidity Risk to Banks
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business, Federal Reserve Bank of New York and New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business

detail.title: Transformed Intermediation:  Credit Risk to NBFIs, Liquidity Risk to Banks
detail.abstract:
We argue that the rapid asset growth of nonbank financial intermediaries (NBFIs) relative to banks is the outcome of transformations of risks between banks and NBFIs that increase the interconnectedness of the two sectors. These transformations are consistent with avoiding tighter, post-GFC bank regulation while harnessing the funding and liquidity advantages of bank deposit franchises and access to safety nets. Specifically, we show that banks fund NBFIs through senior loans and credit lines, which NBFIs use for acquiring junior credit claims, warehouse financing, and liquidity management. We empirically demonstrate that shocks experienced by NBFIs spillover to the banks that provide them with credit lines, particularly in times of stress. We then describe a number of policy approaches that are consistent with our transformation view and conclude with suggestions for future research.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 银行与非银行金融机构之间的风险转移导致两者关联性增强，银行通过高级贷款和信贷额度为NBFIs提供资金，NBFIs将这些资金用于次级信贷、仓储融资和流动性管理，NBFIs的冲击会传导至为其提供信贷的银行。
AI.research_question: 非银行金融机构相对于银行的资产快速增长如何影响银行与NBFIs之间的风险转移和相互关联性？
AI.motivation: 后金融危机时期银行监管趋严，银行通过与非银行金融机构的风险转移来规避监管，同时利用银行的存款特许经营权和安全网优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险转移理论、金融中介理论、监管套利理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 理论分析与实证研究相结合，通过实证数据展示NBFIs冲击如何传导至银行，特别是在压力时期
AI.findings: 银行通过高级贷款和信贷额度为NBFIs提供资金，NBFIs将这些资金用于次级信贷、仓储融资和流动性管理；NBFIs的冲击会传导至为其提供信贷的银行，尤其在压力时期更为明显
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了银行与NBFIs之间风险转移和相互关联性的理论框架，解释了后金融危机时期金融体系结构变化的理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了理解银行与NBFIs相互关联性的政策视角，提出了与风险转移观点一致的政策建议，为未来研究指明了方向

title: Do GLP-1 Medications Pay for Themselves?
affiliations: Indiana University, Indiana University, University of Wisconsin-Madison and Indiana University

detail.title: Do GLP-1 Medications Pay for Themselves?
detail.abstract:
Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1s) represent a major improvement in treatment of diabetes, obesity, and cardiovascular risk reduction, but they are also among the most expensive drugs in widespread use and the subject of significant policy debate. The high price of these drugs may overstate their net cost if the health improvements they produce lead to reduced downstream health care use and medical spending, that is, cost offsets. We estimate such offsets using insurance claims data, examining the effects of GLP-1 initiation on subsequent GLP-1 use and spending, and on other non-GLP-1 spending. We use a stacked difference-in-differences design, comparing patients initiating GLP-1 medication to not-yet-treated controls who initiate GLP-1s several months or years later, allowing us to control for underlying time trends and baseline characteristics. Overall, we do not find a reduction in downstream medical spending. Although GLP-1 initiation reduces spending on other diabetes medications, total non-GLP-1 spending increases, driven by higher outpatient health care use; GLP- 1 drug spending rises mechanically. For health care payers, the relevant cost of GLP-1 initiation therefore extends beyond the sticker price of the drug. We find similar results across subgroups of GLP1 initiators including those with prior cardiovascular disease and those without diabetes (consistent with obesity indication). Our main results examine spending responses over the first year after initiation. However, we also estimate longer run effects in a smaller sample and find no cost offsets even five years after GLP-1 initiation. Taken together, these results suggest that payers facing the costs of GLP-1 coverage are unlikely to see large savings from reduced spending on other care. If GLP-1 therapies ultimately yield cost savings, they are likely to occur only over longer horizons or through non-medical channels.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用保险索赔数据，通过堆叠双重差分法分析GLP-1受体激动剂（治疗糖尿病和肥胖症的药物）的启动是否通过减少下游医疗支出产生成本抵消效应。研究发现，尽管GLP-1减少了其他糖尿病药物的支出，但非GLP-1总支出反而增加（主要由门诊医疗使用增加驱动），且GLP-1药物支出本身也上升。即使在启动后五年内，也未发现成本抵消效应，表明支付方不太可能从其他医疗支出的减少中获得显著节省。
AI.research_question: GLP-1受体激动剂的启动是否通过改善健康状况、减少下游医疗使用而产生成本抵消效应？
AI.motivation: GLP-1s是治疗糖尿病、肥胖症和降低心血管风险的重要药物，但价格昂贵且政策争议大。如果这些药物能通过改善健康减少后续医疗支出，其净成本可能低于表面价格，这对支付方的成本效益评估至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本抵消理论：医疗干预可能通过预防并发症、减少其他治疗需求等方式降低总体医疗支出。该研究检验GLP-1药物是否产生此类抵消效应。
AI.method: 使用保险索赔数据，采用堆叠双重差分设计，比较开始使用GLP-1药物的患者与尚未开始使用（但未来会使用）的对照组，控制时间趋势和基线特征。主要分析启动后第一年的支出变化，并在较小样本中估计长达五年的长期效应。
AI.findings: 1. GLP-1启动减少了其他糖尿病药物的支出；2. 但非GLP-1总支出增加，主要由门诊医疗使用增加驱动；3. GLP-1药物支出本身上升；4. 在心血管疾病患者和非糖尿病患者（肥胖适应症）亚组中结果相似；5. 即使在启动后五年内也未发现成本抵消效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了关于高效但昂贵药物可能通过减少下游医疗支出实现成本抵消的假设，为医疗技术评估中的成本效益分析提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗支付方（如保险公司、政府医保）提供了GLP-1药物覆盖成本评估的关键证据；2. 表明支付方不应期望通过减少其他医疗支出来抵消GLP-1的高成本；3. 提示如果GLP-1疗法能产生成本节约，可能仅通过非医疗渠道或在更长期实现。

title: Platform Work: Evidence from Drivers in India, Indonesia, and Kenya
affiliations: University of California, San Diego (UCSD), IDinsight, IDinsight, IDinsight, Independent Researcher, Independent Researcher and IDinsight

detail.title: Platform Work: Evidence from Drivers in India, Indonesia, and Kenya
detail.abstract:
Using surveys and administrative data from representative samples of drivers working on three leading gig platforms in India, Indonesia, and Kenya, we document the composition, economic experiences, and labor market trajectories of platform workers. Combining platform-based earnings with operating cost data, we estimate earnings net of costs (in PPP-adjusted terms) in each context. We find that the flexible nature of platform work enables drivers to work substantially more than the full-time equivalent, generating higher monthly net earnings than low-skill or casual employment, despite comparable or lower hourly net earnings relative to these outside options. Drivers who exit platform work in India and Indonesia do so to take up better-paying full-time positions. In contrast, Kenyan drivers often exit involuntarily, returning to offline driving with adverse financial consequences. One-third of drivers across countries rely on platform work to supplement earnings during emergencies or slow work periods, suggesting that platform work may play an important role as a financial safety net.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过印度、印尼和肯尼亚三个发展中国家网约车平台司机的调查和行政数据，分析了平台工作的经济体验和劳动力市场轨迹。研究发现平台工作的灵活性使司机能超时工作，月净收入高于低技能或临时工作，但时薪可能更低。不同国家司机退出平台的原因和后果存在差异，平台工作在三成司机中扮演财务安全网角色。
AI.research_question: 平台工作在发展中国家劳动力市场中的角色是什么？平台工作的经济体验如何？平台工作者的劳动力市场轨迹是怎样的？
AI.motivation: 随着零工经济在全球范围内的扩张，特别是在发展中国家，了解平台工作对当地劳动力市场的影响、平台工作者的经济状况以及他们的职业发展轨迹变得日益重要。现有研究多关注发达国家，对发展中国家的平台工作缺乏系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场理论、零工经济理论、收入不平等理论、发展中国家就业结构理论
AI.method: 使用印度、印尼和肯尼亚三个发展中国家代表性网约车平台司机的调查数据和行政数据，结合平台收入和运营成本数据，计算购买力平价调整后的净收入，分析平台工作的经济体验和劳动力市场轨迹。
AI.findings: 1. 平台工作的灵活性使司机能够超时工作，月净收入高于低技能或临时工作，尽管时薪可能相当或更低；2. 印度和印尼司机退出平台主要是为了获得更高薪的全职工作，而肯尼亚司机则多因非自愿原因退出，返回线下驾驶并面临财务困境；3. 约三分之一的司机依赖平台工作作为紧急情况或工作淡季的收入补充，表明平台工作可能扮演重要的财务安全网角色。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了零工经济理论在发展中国家的应用；2. 揭示了平台工作在不同发展中国家劳动力市场中的差异化角色；3. 提出了平台工作作为财务安全网的理论框架；4. 丰富了发展中国家非正规就业和平台经济交叉领域的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家政策制定者提供平台工作监管的实证依据；2. 帮助平台公司了解不同市场环境下司机的需求和挑战；3. 为劳动力市场参与者提供平台工作经济价值的量化评估；4. 为国际组织和发展机构提供零工经济在发展中国家的影响分析。

title: Price Risk Management through NCDEX Futures: Evidence from the Indian Coriander Market
affiliations: Indian Institute of Plantation Management

detail.title: Price Risk Management through NCDEX Futures: Evidence from the Indian Coriander Market
detail.abstract: Aim: This study explores the effectiveness of NCDEX futures contracts in reducing price risks for coriander crops (stakeholders). NCDEX (National Commodity and Derivatives Exchange) offers futures contracts to manage risks, hedging practices, and price discovery mechanisms. Study Design: Non-probability and purposive sampling techniques are used for the study area, sample size selection, and selection of stakeholders as they are selected based on language, time duration, some telephonic interviews, etc, and convenience sampling is used for the preparation of the questionnaire through Google form .Analysis the all phases using technical indicators like Candle stick chart, Bollinger bands, %B, ADX-Average Directional Index, Moving Average Exponential (EMA) and Relative Strength Index (RSI),MACD- Moving Average Convergence and Divergence, CCI-Commodity Channel Index, and Stochastic RSI provides more valuable insights for anticipating future trends. Econometric models like VAR (Vector Auto-Regression) was used especially in monthly prices of Coriander crop. Methodology: In this study, data was collected from primary and secondary sources such as farmers in major coriander cultivating areas, and NCDEX data respectively.
