title: From Impossible Trinity to Stablecoin: A Resource-Capital-Information (RCI) Framework for Monetary Anchors
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Impossible Trinity to Stablecoin: A Resource-Capital-Information (RCI) Framework for Monetary Anchors

declarations.declarationOfInterest: nil
declarations.ethicsApproval: n/a
declarations.funderStatement: nil

detail.abstract: This study revisits the classic theory of the "impossible trinity" by extending its analytical logic from international monetary regimes to blockchain governance and stablecoin design. It develops the Resource-Capital-Information (RCI) framework, distinguishing between ideal anchors (R, C, I) and their degraded forms (r, c, i), and demonstrates how these anchors shape the stability, independence, and transparency of monetary institutions. Through historical cases-including the gold standard, Bretton Woods, Argentina's currency board, the euro, and SDRs-and contemporary cases such as USDT, USDC, DAI, Terra-LUNA, Bitcoin, and CBDCs, the study shows that single anchors offer strength but rigidity, composite anchors provide complementarity but amplify fragility in crises, and stablecoins embody a "three-anchor paradox": stable but not independent, independent but not transparent, transparent but not stable. To address these systemic dilemmas, the paper proposes the RCI triple-anchor model, which integrates resource scarcity, institutional independence, and informational transparency as complementary dimensions. This model not only clarifies the structural isomorphism of monetary and technological governance but also offers policy guidance for stablecoin regulation, CBDC design, and global monetary coordination. The RCI triple-anchor model offers a systemic pathway for stablecoin regulation, resilient CBDC design, and multipolar global monetary governance.

AI.tldr: 该研究将"不可能三角"理论扩展到区块链治理和稳定币设计，提出资源-资本-信息(RCI)框架，分析货币锚点如何影响稳定性、独立性和透明度，并通过历史与当代案例揭示单一锚点、复合锚点及稳定币的"三锚悖论"，最终提出RCI三锚模型作为系统性解决方案。
AI.research_question: 如何将"不可能三角"理论的分析逻辑从国际货币体系扩展到区块链治理和稳定币设计？资源、资本、信息三种锚点如何影响货币机构的稳定性、独立性和透明度？稳定币面临的三锚悖论如何解决？
AI.motivation: 传统"不可能三角"理论主要应用于国际货币体系，但随着区块链技术和稳定币的发展，需要新的理论框架来分析数字时代的货币治理问题。现有稳定币设计面临稳定性、独立性和透明度之间的权衡困境，需要系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 不可能三角理论（Impossible Trinity）的扩展应用；2. 资源-资本-信息(RCI)框架，区分理想锚点(R,C,I)和退化形式(r,c,i)；3. 三锚悖论理论；4. 货币锚点的结构同构性理论。
AI.method: 采用历史案例比较分析法（金本位、布雷顿森林体系、阿根廷货币局、欧元、SDR）和当代案例分析法（USDT、USDC、DAI、Terra-LUNA、比特币、CBDC），通过理论框架构建和案例验证相结合的方法。
AI.findings: 1. 单一锚点提供强度但缺乏灵活性；2. 复合锚点提供互补性但在危机中放大脆弱性；3. 稳定币存在"三锚悖论"：稳定但不独立、独立但不透明、透明但不稳定；4. 历史案例验证了锚点选择的系统性影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将不可能三角理论扩展到区块链和稳定币领域；2. 提出RCI三锚模型作为系统性分析框架；3. 揭示了货币治理与科技治理的结构同构性；4. 发展了稳定币的三锚悖论理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为稳定币监管提供政策指导；2. 为CBDC设计提供弹性框架；3. 为全球货币协调提供多极化治理路径；4. 为货币机构设计提供系统性解决方案。

title: Credit Risk Evaluation of Small, Medium, and Micro-Enterprises Based on Recurrent Neural Networks
affiliations: University of the Punjab

detail.title: Credit Risk Evaluation of Small, Medium, and Micro-Enterprises Based on Recurrent Neural Networks
detail.abstract: Small, medium, and micro-enterprises (SMMEs) are vital to China's economy but face high credit risks due to limited assets and volatile revenues. This study proposes a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) model to assess SMME credit risk using time-series financial and operational indicators. Principal component analysis (PCA) refines indicators, followed by RNN training to predict risk levels (low, medium, high). Applied to 500 SMMEs' data (2019-2021), the model achieves 85.3% accuracy, outperforming logistic regression (78.6%). The approach captures sequential patterns, aiding banks in lending decisions. Limitations include data availability and computational demands. Results offer insights for policymakers and financial institutions.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于循环神经网络(RNN)的时间序列模型，用于评估中国中小微企业信用风险。通过主成分分析(PCA)优化财务和运营指标，RNN模型在500家企业数据上达到85.3%的准确率，优于逻辑回归(78.6%)。
AI.research_question: 如何利用循环神经网络(RNN)模型有效评估中国中小微企业(SMMEs)的信用风险？
AI.motivation: 中小微企业对中国经济至关重要，但由于资产有限和收入波动性大，面临较高的信用风险。传统信用评估方法可能无法充分捕捉其风险特征，需要更先进的模型来改善风险评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 信用风险评估理论；2) 时间序列分析理论；3) 机器学习在金融风险管理中的应用；4) 主成分分析(PCA)降维理论；5) 循环神经网络(RNN)序列建模理论。
AI.method: 1) 收集500家中小微企业2019-2021年的财务和运营数据；2) 使用主成分分析(PCA)优化指标选择；3) 构建循环神经网络(RNN)模型处理时间序列数据；4) 预测三类风险等级(低、中、高)；5) 与逻辑回归模型进行性能对比。
AI.findings: 1) RNN模型达到85.3%的准确率，显著优于逻辑回归的78.6%；2) 模型能够有效捕捉财务和运营指标的序列模式；3) 时间序列方法能够更好地反映中小微企业的动态风险特征；4) 模型有助于银行做出更准确的贷款决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将循环神经网络(RNN)应用于中小微企业信用风险评估，拓展了机器学习在金融风险管理中的应用；2) 提出了结合PCA和RNN的时间序列风险评估框架；3) 为中小微企业风险评估提供了新的理论视角，强调序列模式的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为银行和金融机构提供更准确的中小微企业信用风险评估工具；2) 帮助政策制定者更好地理解中小微企业风险特征；3) 提高中小微企业获得融资的机会；4) 降低金融机构的信贷风险。

title: Anatomy of AI-Driven Socioeconomic Strain: Modeling the Nation-State as an Energy-Flow System (Part 1: United States)
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Anatomy of AI-Driven Socioeconomic Strain: Modeling the Nation-State as an Energy-Flow System (Part 1: United States)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Author has no financial, personal or business interaction with any of the specific institutions and organizations that may have been mentioned.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not Applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: Author has solely self-funded this paper.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces an energy-flow framework for analyzing the macroeconomic implications of rapid software-AI substitution in advanced economies. Conceptualizing the nation-state as a thermodynamic-like system—where physically grounded labor (CAT1) generates primary value, cognitive information-processing labor (CAT2) amplifies and converts it, and dependent populations (CAT3 + CAT4) represent expanding sinks—we model the contraction of operable economic surplus under converging technological, demographic, and fiscal pressures.

Using the United States as the initial case, detailed occupational demarcation and conservative assumptions about AI capability scaling (∼100× effective improvement in relevant tasks by the mid-2030s) yield baseline projections of substantial socioeconomic strain. The largest acceleration of timelines occurs when the replaceability ratio (REP%) exceeds 20%—a level even below the predicted rates of some major mainstream models such as CBO and McKinsey—while this paper's model calculates replaceability to approach 41%. Sensitivity analyses varying replacement intensity, immigration flows, deficit financing, and entitlement growth reveal material probabilistic risks of critical threshold crossings—defined by the Contraction Scale Metric (CSM) and Effective Burden Rate (EBR) approaching depletion—within a 12–36-year horizon. Traditional policy levers provide only marginal and transient mitigation.

The framework highlights structural vulnerabilities: as AI erodes the convertible labor layer at near-zero marginal cost, demographic aging and statutory commitments amplify surplus contraction.

This study establishes the methodological foundation for this analysis, with the U.S. serving as the initial case; subsequent papers in this series will extend the framework to all G20 nations, which face analogous converging demographic, fiscal, and technological pressures but with unique factors and influences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个能量流框架分析发达经济体快速软件-AI替代的宏观经济影响。将国家视为热力学系统，模拟在技术、人口和财政压力下可操作经济剩余的收缩。以美国为例，预测到2030年代中期AI能力提升约100倍时，社会经济将面临显著压力，替代率可能达41%，传统政策工具只能提供有限缓解。
AI.research_question: 快速软件-AI替代在发达经济体中的宏观经济影响是什么？特别是在技术、人口和财政压力收敛的情况下，可操作经济剩余如何收缩？
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展正在改变劳动力市场结构，同时发达经济体面临人口老龄化、财政压力等多重挑战。需要理解这些因素如何相互作用，以及它们对经济剩余的长期影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学类比框架：将国家视为能量系统，CAT1（物理基础劳动）创造主要价值，CAT2（认知信息处理劳动）放大和转换价值，CAT3+CAT4（依赖人口）代表扩张的消耗端。使用替代率（REP%）、收缩规模指标（CSM）和有效负担率（EBR）等指标。
AI.method: 采用详细的职业划分和保守的AI能力扩展假设（到2030年代中期相关任务效率提升约100倍）。以美国为初始案例，进行敏感性分析，考虑替代强度、移民流动、赤字融资和福利增长等变量。
AI.findings: 当替代率超过20%时出现最大加速，模型计算替代率接近41%。在12-36年时间范围内，存在关键阈值跨越的实质性概率风险。传统政策工具只能提供边际和暂时的缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个创新的能量流分析框架，将宏观经济建模与热力学系统类比相结合。建立了结构脆弱性分析的理论基础，为理解AI替代、人口结构和财政压力的相互作用提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了量化风险评估工具（CSM和EBR），识别了替代率20%的关键阈值。建立了可扩展到G20国家的方法论基础，帮助各国评估自身在类似压力下的脆弱性。

title: Policy Learning for Payment Compliance: Out-of Time Evidence on the Value-and Limits-of ML Targeting at a Brazilian Water Utility
affiliations: Lehigh University, , Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Information & Systems Management, Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST) - Department of Management & Organization and Boston University - Questrom School of Business

detail.title: Policy Learning for Payment Compliance: Out-of Time Evidence on the Value-and Limits-of ML Targeting at a Brazilian Water Utility

declarations.ethicsApproval: Exempt status was granted by Lehigh University's IRB.

detail.abstract: Water utilities in emerging markets face a finance problem disguised as an operations problem: chronic late payments reduce cash flow, raise financing needs, and ultimately threaten service provision. We partner with a large Brazilian water and sewer utility and run a preregistered randomized controlled trial with approximately 160,000 customers to test behaviorally informed SMS reminders delivered one day before the bill due date. We compare four theory-based message frames-personal benefit (credit building), personal cost (credit harm), collective benefit (public good provision), and social norm (injunctive). In the first month, the credit-focused frames perform best on average, increasing on-time payment by about one percentage point relative to the utility's standard reminder (a 3.7% increase over a 27% baseline). We also find that responses vary with prior payment behavior. Customers with strong payment histories respond most to the credit-building appeal, while chronically delinquent customers respond more to collective and norm-based messages. Motivated by this heterogeneity, we train machine learning models on administrative billing data to target customers with one of the messages and experimentally evaluate the resulting decision policy in an out-of-time, on-policy holdout field test five months later. In this test, personalized messaging increases on-time payment by 2.4 percentage points relative to control, but we observe no statistically significant gain relative to the best-on-average message (2.1 percentage points). Together, the results show the value of behaviorally informed text messages and the limits of ML-based targeting for personalization.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过巴西水务公司的随机对照试验，测试了四种行为短信提醒对按时缴费的影响，发现信用框架效果最佳，但不同客户群体反应不同。机器学习个性化推送虽有提升，但相比最佳通用信息优势有限。
AI.research_question: 行为短信提醒的不同信息框架如何影响新兴市场水务用户的按时缴费行为？机器学习个性化推送能否进一步提升效果？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场水务公司面临严重的逾期缴费问题，这表面上是运营问题，实质是财务问题，影响现金流和服务提供。需要低成本有效的干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于行为经济学理论框架：个人利益（信用建设）、个人成本（信用损害）、集体利益（公共产品提供）和社会规范（禁令性规范）。
AI.method: 与巴西大型水务公司合作，对约16万客户进行预注册随机对照试验，比较四种理论框架的短信提醒效果。五个月后使用机器学习模型进行个性化推送的现场测试。
AI.findings: 1. 信用框架（个人利益和成本）平均效果最佳，提高按时缴费率约1个百分点（相对27%基准提高3.7%）。2. 不同客户反应不同：良好缴费记录客户对信用建设信息反应最强，长期逾期客户对集体和社会规范信息反应更强。3. 机器学习个性化推送提高2.4个百分点，但与最佳通用信息相比无显著优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了行为经济学框架在新兴市场公用事业缴费中的应用效果。2. 揭示了客户异质性对信息框架反应的差异。3. 探讨了机器学习个性化推送的理论边界和实际限制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为水务公司提供了低成本有效的短信干预方案。2. 展示了针对不同客户群体的差异化沟通策略。3. 为公用事业公司实施行为干预提供了实证依据和操作指南。

title: Predicting Heatwave Vulnerability Using Spatial Analytics and Demographic Data

detail.title: Predicting Heatwave Vulnerability Using Spatial Analytics and Demographic Data

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.ethicsApproval: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.funderStatement: I declare sole authorship of the article
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: I declare sole authorship of the article

detail.abstract: Heatwaves pose increasing risks to urban populations, particularly in the context of climate change and rapid urbanization. This study aims to predict heatwave vulnerability by integrating spatial analytics with demographic and socioeconomic data to identify populations and areas at greatest risk. Geographic Information Systems (GIS) were employed to map urban heat intensity and overlay demographic variables, including age, income, and population density. Statistical modeling techniques, including Geographically Weighted Principal Component Analysis (GWPCA) and multi-criteria analysis, were applied to quantify vulnerability scores across different neighborhoods. The findings reveal distinct geographic hotspots where high exposure intersects with socioeconomic disadvantage, highlighting communities with heightened susceptibility to heat-related hazards. Vulnerable populations, such as the elderly and low-income households, were disproportionately concentrated in these areas, suggesting systemic disparities in adaptive capacity. These results underscore the importance of targeted intervention strategies, such as heat-health early warning systems, urban greening initiatives, and resource allocation for emergency services. By providing spatially explicit vulnerability assessments, the study offers actionable insights for policymakers, urban planners, and public health officials to enhance resilience and prioritize at-risk communities in heatwave preparedness and response efforts. Overall, the integration of spatial and demographic analyses demonstrates a robust framework for anticipating climate-related risks and supports evidence-based decision-making for climate adaptation planning (D'Ambrosio et al., 2023; Bhattarai et al., 2024).

AI.tldr: 本研究整合空间分析与人口社会经济数据，预测城市热浪脆弱性，识别高风险区域和人群，为政策制定提供空间明确的脆弱性评估框架。
AI.research_question: 如何通过整合空间分析与人口社会经济数据来预测城市热浪脆弱性，并识别高风险区域和人群？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和快速城市化背景下，热浪对城市人口的风险日益增加，需要识别最脆弱的区域和人群以制定针对性干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于空间脆弱性理论，整合热暴露、社会经济敏感性和适应能力三个维度，构建热浪脆弱性评估框架。
AI.method: 采用地理信息系统(GIS)绘制城市热强度图，叠加人口变量(年龄、收入、人口密度)；应用地理加权主成分分析(GWPCA)和多准则分析量化不同社区的脆弱性得分。
AI.findings: 发现明显的地理热点区域，高暴露与社会经济劣势相交叠；老年人和低收入家庭等脆弱人群在这些区域过度集中，显示适应能力的系统性差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了整合空间和人口分析的气候风险预测框架，扩展了城市热浪脆弱性评估的理论方法，强调了空间异质性在脆弱性分析中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、城市规划者和公共卫生官员提供可操作的见解，支持热浪早期预警系统、城市绿化倡议和应急服务资源分配等针对性干预策略。

title: Expectation Setting with Machine Learning
affiliations: Complex Systems Research Group

detail.title: Expectation Setting with Machine Learning
detail.abstract: The formation of expectations lies at the heart of economic behaviour and hence agentbased modelling of that behaviour. Though many observations and relationships about which expectations are formed could be represented as functions, not all can be specified as such. In these cases, machine learning algorithms, specifically non-parametric nonlinear regressions known as neural networks, can help us model expectations with functional forms is are unknown, heterogenous, or untidy. We present two machine learning implementations of expectation settings. In the first, a firm form expectations about household demand, and in the second, a firm forms expectations about workers' effort responses to wages. The results are evaluated against the revealed relationships for heterogenous agents in both static and dynamic conditions.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了在经济学行为建模中，当期望形成的关系无法用明确函数表示时，如何使用机器学习（特别是神经网络）来建模未知、异质或复杂形式的期望形成过程。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习算法（特别是神经网络）来建模经济学中那些无法用明确函数形式表示的期望形成过程？
AI.motivation: 期望形成是经济行为的核心，但在基于主体的建模中，许多期望形成的关系无法用明确的函数形式表示，需要新的建模方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于主体的经济学建模理论，期望形成理论，机器学习在经济学中的应用理论。
AI.method: 使用非参数非线性回归（神经网络）作为机器学习方法，在两个具体情境中实现期望建模：1）企业对家庭需求的期望；2）企业对工人努力程度对工资反应的期望。
AI.findings: 在静态和动态条件下，机器学习方法能够有效建模异质主体的期望形成过程，并与实际揭示的关系进行对比评估。
AI.theory_contributions: 为经济学中期望形成的建模提供了新的方法论框架，扩展了机器学习在行为经济学中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为基于主体的经济模型开发者提供了具体的机器学习实现方案，可用于建模复杂、异质的期望形成过程。

title: Reducing Transport Externalities through Nudging: Results from a GPS-Tracked Experiment
affiliations: University of Basel, University of Basel, Swiss National Bank and

detail.title: Reducing Transport Externalities through Nudging: Results from a GPS-Tracked Experiment
detail.abstract: This study presents a randomized controlled trial in Switzerland to investigate the effects of a non-monetary intervention on transport choices. A GPS-based tracking app records the movements of 814 participants for several months, and automatically detects their travel modes. The treatment consists of sending personalized transport reports to a randomly selected subgroup. These reports contain personalized descriptive and prescriptive information on participants' transport-related external costs. The treatment reduces the climate-related external costs by 5.1% (p=0.05). We find that the treatment effects increase with age and the level of education, and that they decrease with income. Reports with positive prescriptive feedback were correlated with further reductions in external costs, whereas the opposite is true for negative feedback, thus suggesting a ``boomerang effect''. Based on participants' travel response and their willingness-to-pay for future reports, we compute average gross welfare gains of 3.09 Swiss francs per participant and report from a targeted intervention.

AI.tldr: 瑞士随机对照试验显示，发送个性化交通报告（包含外部成本信息）能减少5.1%的气候相关外部成本，效果随年龄和教育水平增加而增强，随收入增加而减弱。正面反馈进一步降低成本，负面反馈产生"回旋镖效应"。平均每份报告产生3.09瑞士法郎的福利收益。
AI.research_question: 非货币干预（个性化交通报告）如何影响人们的交通选择？这种干预对减少交通外部成本的效果如何？干预效果如何随人口特征变化？
AI.motivation: 交通部门是温室气体排放的重要来源，需要有效政策工具来促进可持续交通选择。传统经济激励措施成本高昂，因此探索低成本的非货币干预具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学理论（如信息反馈、社会规范、回旋镖效应）、交通选择理论、外部成本理论、个性化干预理论。
AI.method: 随机对照试验：814名瑞士参与者使用GPS追踪应用记录数月出行数据，随机分组接受个性化交通报告干预（包含描述性和规范性信息），对照组不接受干预。使用GPS自动检测出行模式，量化外部成本变化。
AI.findings: 1. 干预减少5.1%的气候相关外部成本（p=0.05）；2. 效果随年龄和教育水平增加而增强，随收入增加而减弱；3. 正面规范性反馈进一步降低成本，负面反馈产生回旋镖效应；4. 平均每份报告产生3.09瑞士法郎的福利收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证个性化信息反馈在交通行为改变中的有效性；2. 揭示干预效果的人口异质性；3. 证实规范性反馈的方向性影响（正面vs负面）；4. 为行为经济学在交通政策中的应用提供实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供低成本、可扩展的交通政策工具；2. 指导如何设计有效的个性化交通报告；3. 识别最可能受益的目标群体（年长、高教育水平、低收入者）；4. 量化干预的福利收益，支持政策决策。

title: Oil & Gas Transactions in Nigeria: Navigating Compliance, Innovation and Continuity for National Development

detail.title: Oil & Gas Transactions in Nigeria: Navigating Compliance, Innovation and Continuity for National Development
detail.abstract: Nigeria’s oil and gas sector remains the cornerstone of the nation’s economy, contributing over 80% of export revenue and substantial government income in 2025. The Petroleum Industry Act (PIA) 2021, together with its implementing regulations and ongoing amendments, has created a modern regulatory framework that emphasizes transparency, local content, environmental responsibility, and commercial viability. While strict compliance requirements, evolving fiscal terms, and host-community obligations present real challenges, rapid innovation through initiatives such as digital field management, floating LNG, landmark domestic refining, and the rise of capable indigenous operators has begun to reverse years of production decline. Major asset divestments by international oil companies into Nigerian hands, combined with multibillion-dollar field development plans and improved security measures, signal a new phase of growth. This article examines the current legal and operational landscape, highlights practical pathways through the compliance maze, showcases transformative innovations, and identifies the critical steps needed to ensure long-term continuity. It concludes that disciplined adherence to the PIA, sustained technological adoption, and equitable benefit-sharing can convert Nigeria’s vast hydrocarbon resources into lasting national development.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚石油天然气行业在《石油工业法案》(PIA) 2021年框架下的现状，探讨了合规挑战、技术创新和资产转移如何推动行业复苏，并提出了实现长期可持续发展的关键路径。
AI.research_question: 在《石油工业法案》(PIA) 2021年框架下，尼日利亚石油天然气行业如何通过合规管理、技术创新和资产重组实现复苏和长期可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚油气行业占国家出口收入的80%以上，但面临多年产量下降的困境。PIA法案的实施为行业带来了新的监管框架，但严格的合规要求、不断变化的财政条款和社区义务构成了现实挑战，需要研究如何在此新环境下推动行业复苏和可持续发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于制度变迁理论、资源诅咒理论和可持续发展理论，分析监管框架变革对资源型产业发展的影响，探讨技术创新与制度环境的互动关系。
AI.method: 采用定性分析方法，通过文献综述、政策分析和案例研究，考察尼日利亚油气行业的法律环境、运营现状和创新实践。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) PIA法案建立了强调透明度、本地化、环境责任和商业可行性的现代监管框架；2) 数字油田管理、浮式LNG、国内炼油等技术创新开始扭转产量下降趋势；3) 国际石油公司向本土运营商的大规模资产剥离与数十亿美元的油田开发计划相结合，标志着新的增长阶段；4) 合规挑战、财政条款变化和社区义务仍是主要障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1) 丰富了制度变迁理论在资源型产业中的应用，展示了监管框架现代化如何促进产业复苏；2) 深化了对"资源诅咒"规避机制的理解，强调制度创新与技术创新协同的重要性；3) 为发展中国家资源治理提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1) 为行业参与者提供了PIA合规的实用路径；2) 展示了数字化转型、本土化运营等创新实践的成功案例；3) 提出了确保长期连续性的关键步骤：严格遵守PIA、持续技术采用和公平利益分享；4) 为政策制定者提供了促进油气资源转化为国家发展的实施建议。

title: Symbolic Representation, Moral Value Congruence, and Coproduction
affiliations: , University of Pittsburgh and Seattle University

detail.title: Symbolic Representation, Moral Value Congruence, and Coproduction
detail.abstract: Symbolic representation (SR) theory holds that the demographic makeup of public agencies can shape state-citizen interactions, yet empirical evidence on whether representation increases citizens' willingness to coproduce with government remains mixed. We argue that part of this ambiguity stems from under-specifying the interpretive process through which citizens draw inferences from representation when deciding whether to coproduce. We theorize that citizens interpret representation as a cue about an agency's underlying moral commitments, and that representation increases coproduction willingness in part by increasing perceived moral value congruence between citizen and agency, especially among marginalized groups. We test this account in the critical case of American policing. Our pre-registered survey experiment shows that racial representation increases both coproduction willingness and perceived moral value congruence among Black respondents, and that moral value congruence mediates roughly one-third of the SR effects. Counterintuitively, White respondents report lower willingness to coproduce under racial match, and White representation is not associated with perceived moral value congruence, although moral value congruence itself positively predict coproduction intentions. We contribute to the literature by specifying and testing a value-based mediation mechanism and by showing that its strength is conditional on group position. In doing so, we move SR theory toward a more process-oriented account of when and through what interpretive pathway SR shapes state-citizen interactions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了象征性代表如何通过道德价值观一致性感知影响公民与政府的合作意愿，特别关注种族代表在警务情境中的作用。研究发现黑人受访者在种族匹配时合作意愿更高，而白人受访者则相反，道德价值观一致性中介了约三分之一的象征性代表效应。
AI.research_question: 象征性代表（机构的人口构成）如何影响公民与政府的合作意愿？公民如何通过解释代表来推断机构的道德承诺，以及道德价值观一致性在这一过程中起什么中介作用？
AI.motivation: 现有关于象征性代表理论的研究结果不一致，部分原因在于未能充分说明公民如何解释代表并据此决定是否合作的认知过程。需要更清晰地阐明象征性代表影响公民-国家互动的具体机制和条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 象征性代表理论、道德价值观一致性理论、群体位置理论。研究认为公民将代表视为机构道德承诺的线索，代表通过增加感知的道德价值观一致性来影响合作意愿，这一过程受群体地位调节。
AI.method: 预注册的调查研究实验，以美国警务为关键案例。通过实验操作种族代表条件，测量黑人受访者和白人受访者的合作意愿、感知道德价值观一致性等变量，并进行中介效应分析。
AI.findings: 1) 种族代表增加了黑人受访者的合作意愿和感知道德价值观一致性；2) 道德价值观一致性中介了约三分之一的象征性代表效应；3) 白人受访者在种族匹配时合作意愿反而降低；4) 白人代表与感知道德价值观一致性无关，但道德价值观一致性本身正向预测合作意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出并验证了基于价值观的中介机制；2) 展示了该机制的强度受群体地位调节；3) 推动象征性代表理论向更过程导向的解释发展，阐明象征性代表何时以及通过何种解释路径影响公民-国家互动。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为公共机构（特别是警务部门）的多元化招聘和代表性建设提供理论依据；2) 揭示了不同群体对代表的不同反应模式；3) 强调了建立道德价值观一致性的重要性，而不仅仅是人口统计学上的代表。

title: Beyond Financial Dominance: A Multi Ledger Architecture for Modern Organizational Performance

detail.title: Beyond Financial Dominance: A Multi Ledger Architecture for Modern Organizational Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not require ethics approval because it involved no human participants, identifiable data, or experimental procedures.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Contemporary organizations operate in environments characterized by complexity, interdependence, and rapid information flows, yet most continue to rely on accounting architectures developed for industrial-era production systems. Traditional financial accounting was designed to satisfy external reporting requirements and gradually evolved into an internal performance regime that favors financial indicators over other forms of organizational value. Research across management accounting, organizational behavior, and financialization demonstrates that this single-ledger architecture produces systematic distortions, including the concentration of decision rights, the marginalization of cross-functional expertise, and the underinvestment in capacity, learning, and long-term organizational health. These distortions are not isolated but structural, emerging predictably from the dominance of financial metrics in internal governance systems. 

This white paper introduces Integrated Value Architecture (IVA), a multi-ledger accounting and performance framework that addresses these structural limitations. IVA expands the accounting architecture to include five ledgers capturing financial performance, operational quality, organizational capacity, externalities and equity, and learning and innovation. The framework integrates these ledgers into a coherent performance system supported by a governance model that distributes interpretive authority across functions. IVA contributes to ongoing debates in accounting and governance by offering a structural mechanism for reducing financial dominance, improving decision quality, and aligning performance systems with traditional organizational demands. The framework provides leaders with a more comprehensive representation of value creation and supports the development of resilient, equitable, and strategically coherent organizations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出集成价值架构（IVA），这是一个多分类账会计与绩效框架，旨在解决传统单一分类账会计系统在复杂组织环境中产生的结构性扭曲问题。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个会计架构，能够克服传统财务主导的单一分类账系统在复杂组织环境中产生的结构性扭曲，从而更全面地反映价值创造？
AI.motivation: 当代组织在复杂、相互依赖且信息快速流动的环境中运营，但大多数仍依赖为工业时代生产系统设计的会计架构。传统财务会计主要满足外部报告要求，逐渐演变为内部绩效体系，偏重财务指标而忽视其他形式的组织价值，导致系统性扭曲。
AI.theoretical_framework: 管理会计、组织行为学和金融化研究；集成价值架构（IVA）理论框架；多分类账会计系统理论；组织治理与绩效测量理论。
AI.method: 概念框架开发方法；理论构建方法；基于现有研究的概念分析；提出IVA框架作为解决方案。
AI.findings: 传统单一分类账会计架构产生系统性扭曲：决策权集中、跨职能专业知识边缘化、对能力、学习和长期组织健康投资不足。这些扭曲是结构性的，源于财务指标在内部治理系统中的主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出集成价值架构（IVA）理论框架，扩展会计架构至五个分类账：财务绩效、运营质量、组织能力、外部性与公平性、学习与创新。为减少财务主导、提高决策质量、使绩效系统与组织需求保持一致提供了结构性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供更全面的价值创造表征；支持发展有韧性、公平且战略一致的组织；提供具体的治理模型，将解释权分配至各职能部门；帮助组织应对复杂环境中的管理挑战。

title: The Lender of Last Resort and Moral Hazard Reassessing the Legal Basis of Central Bank Liquidity Support
affiliations: University of Zurich - Rechtswissenschaftliches Institut (School of Law)

detail.title: The Lender of Last Resort and Moral Hazard Reassessing the Legal Basis of Central Bank Liquidity Support
detail.abstract: The modern formulation of the lender of last resort (LOLR) was coined by Walter Bagehot in 1873 in his work Lombard Street (Bagehot, 1873). Bagehot argued that one of the main functions of a central bank was to maintain financial stability during times of market distress by providing emergency liquidity assistance in the form of loans to solvent but illiquid banks that are no longer able to refinance their operations on the markets. To limit moral hazard, central bank lending should be at a penalty interest rate and based on good collateral. In the twentieth century, many central banks began to follow a policy of 'constructive ambiguity', which means that the LOLR would have the right to intervene in a crisis but will not promise in advance to do so. During the banking crisis of the 1980s and again during the global financial crisis (GFC) of 2007-2008, however, central bank lending to financial institutions was done at artificially low interest rates that did not reflect the credit risk of those institutions. These moves depart from the traditional principle established by Bagehot and mirror the strong interdependence between governments and central banks, on the one hand, and commercial banks, on the other. Following these crises, central banks have been following an alternative version of the LOLR principle in which lending to ailing institutions and markets would be automatically triggered if the values of bank and market assets suddenly dropped or became volatile. This paper analyzes what types of moral hazard these evolving central bank practices have created and the related legal framework and what this means for the "lender of last resort" principle and the credibility of central banks and governments.

AI.tldr: 本文分析央行最后贷款人原则的演变，从巴杰特传统原则到现代实践，探讨这些变化如何引发道德风险及其对央行和政府信誉的影响。
AI.research_question: 央行最后贷款人原则的演变实践创造了哪些类型的道德风险？这对"最后贷款人"原则以及央行和政府的信誉意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 现代央行在实践中偏离了巴杰特确立的传统最后贷款人原则（惩罚性利率、良好抵押品），在1980年代银行危机和2008年全球金融危机期间以人为低利率提供贷款，这反映了政府、央行与商业银行之间的强相互依存关系。这些演变实践需要分析其产生的道德风险问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最后贷款人理论（巴杰特原则）、道德风险理论、金融稳定理论、央行独立性理论、政府-银行关系理论
AI.method: 理论分析、历史比较分析、政策演变分析、法律框架分析
AI.findings: 1. 央行实践偏离巴杰特原则，从惩罚性利率转向人为低利率；2. 从"建设性模糊"转向自动触发机制；3. 这些变化创造了系统性道德风险；4. 反映了政府-央行-商业银行的强相互依存关系；5. 对央行信誉和金融稳定产生负面影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了最后贷款人理论在现代金融环境下的适用性分析；2. 深化了央行道德风险形成机制的理论理解；3. 提出了央行信誉与政策有效性关系的理论框架；4. 丰富了政府-央行-银行关系理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行政策制定者提供道德风险管理的实践指导；2. 为金融监管改革提供政策建议；3. 帮助评估央行干预措施的有效性和成本；4. 为维护央行和政府信誉提供实践路径

title: Modelling the Fiscal Implications of Alternative Minimum Support Price (MSP) Policy Scenarios in Indian Agriculture
affiliations: Carnegie Mellon University and  ICAR- National Institute of Biotic Stress Management

detail.title: Modelling the Fiscal Implications of Alternative Minimum Support Price (MSP) Policy Scenarios in Indian Agriculture
detail.abstract: The Minimum Support Price (MSP) policy is central to farm income stabilisation and food security in India, but extending assured procurement beyond paddy and wheat to all 23 notified crops raises significant fiscal and operational concerns. This paper estimates the fiscal implications of MSP implementation under three alternative policy scenarios for the marketing year 2024-25: (i) partial procurement, (ii) partial Price Deficiency Payment (PDP), and (iii) universal PDP. Using crop-wise production, MSP, and modal market price data from Agmarknet and CEDA, the study assesses government expenditure, disposal revenues, and net fiscal burden under each scenario. Under partial procurement, assuming procurement of 40% of paddy and wheat and 20% of other crops, total farmer payouts amount to ₹4.67 lakh crore (1.4% of GDP), with a net fiscal burden of ₹28,891 to ₹52,171 crore (0.09 to 0.16% of GDP) after accounting for disposal revenues. The partial PDP scenario, which retains procurement for paddy and wheat while extending PDP to 20% of output of other crops, entails similar fiscal costs but improves efficiency by reducing storage and logistics requirements. Universal PDP marginally increases expenditure but eliminates inventoryrelated costs, enhancing administrative simplicity. The results favour a hybrid MSP framework, procurement for paddy and wheat combined with PDP for other crops as a fiscally prudent and operationally efficient reform aligned with international best practices.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了印度MSP政策三种实施方案的财政影响：部分采购、部分价格差额支付和全面价格差额支付，发现混合方案（水稻小麦采购+其他作物价格差额支付）在财政和运营上最优。
AI.research_question: 不同MSP政策实施方案（部分采购、部分价格差额支付、全面价格差额支付）对印度财政负担和运营效率的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 印度最低支持价格政策对农民收入稳定和粮食安全至关重要，但将保证采购扩展到所有23种指定作物存在显著的财政和运营问题，需要评估不同政策方案的可行性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业价格支持政策理论、财政负担分析框架、政策效率评估理论、国际最佳实践比较理论。
AI.method: 使用Agmarknet和CEDA的作物产量、MSP和市场价格数据，对2024-25营销年度的三种政策方案进行财政影响评估，包括政府支出、处置收入和净财政负担计算。
AI.findings: 部分采购方案下农民支付总额达4.67万亿卢比（GDP的1.4%），净财政负担为2889-5217亿卢比（GDP的0.09-0.16%）；部分价格差额支付方案财政成本相似但运营效率更高；全面价格差额支付方案支出略增但消除了库存成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农业价格支持政策提供了系统的财政影响评估框架，发展了混合MSP政策理论，丰富了发展中国家农业政策改革的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度政府提供了具体的政策改革建议：采用混合MSP框架（水稻小麦采购+其他作物价格差额支付），这一方案财政审慎、运营高效，符合国际最佳实践。

title: Did the Thieves Steal our Taxes? An Essay on the Innocent Frauds that Perpetuate Economic Misunderstandings over the Corruption Scandal and Philippine Policymaking
affiliations: De La Salle University, University of Missouri at Kansas City,  and De La Salle University

detail.title: Did the Thieves Steal our Taxes? An Essay on the Innocent Frauds that Perpetuate Economic Misunderstandings over the Corruption Scandal and Philippine Policymaking
detail.abstract: Like any modern government, the Philippine government spends, by law, reserve balances created by BSP ex nihilo, not taxes. This process creates money. This implies the following: (i) the recently discovered massive misappropriation of government funds earmarked for infrastructure projects means that taxes have not been stolen; (ii) this is so because it is impossible to steal taxes. In the accounting procedures of modern economies these are returned to Treasury and, ultimately, to BSP and then "destroyed". This is the law; (iii) the thieves have stolen bank deposits that were intended for projects. However, deposits are not how tax payments are ultimately settled with the government; (iv) the thieves must be punished but their actions have not made BSP and the Philippine Government poorer; and (v) the Philippine government can financially afford to construct the infrastructure that was not built. Corruption makes things worse but it is not the Philippines' original sin. We end by arguing that, as the Philippine government is not financially constrained, it needs to implement a much more active fiscal strategy for the country to develop.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了关于政府财政的传统观点，认为菲律宾政府通过央行创造货币来支出，而非依赖税收。腐败挪用的是银行存款而非税收，政府实际上没有财务约束，应实施更积极的财政政策促进发展。
AI.research_question: 腐败挪用政府基础设施资金是否等同于偷税？现代货币体系下政府支出的本质是什么？菲律宾政府是否真的面临财务约束？
AI.motivation: 针对菲律宾基础设施项目资金被大规模挪用的丑闻，论文旨在澄清公众对政府财政运作的误解，特别是关于税收、政府支出和货币创造的关系，为更积极的财政政策提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 现代货币理论（MMT）框架，强调主权货币国家政府通过央行创造货币支出，税收用于调节通胀而非融资；政府会计和货币结算体系；主权货币国家的财政空间理论。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论论证，基于现代货币体系的制度安排和会计程序，分析菲律宾政府财政运作的实际机制，驳斥传统财政观点。
AI.findings: 1. 腐败挪用的是银行存款而非税收；2. 税收在会计上最终返还央行并被"销毁"；3. 腐败未使央行和政府变穷；4. 政府仍有财力建设未完成的基础设施；5. 政府实际上没有财务约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 澄清主权货币国家政府支出的货币创造本质；2. 区分税收功能和政府融资机制；3. 挑战"政府预算约束"的传统观念；4. 为发展中国家积极财政政策提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 纠正公众对腐败性质的误解；2. 为菲律宾政府实施积极财政政策扫除心理障碍；3. 指出腐败是治理问题而非财政约束问题；4. 呼吁更主动的发展战略。

title: A Geometric Theory of Incentive Robustness and Control
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: A Geometric Theory of Incentive Robustness and Control
detail.abstract: We develop a geometric theory of incentives that unifies games, nudges, language, market structure, and collective cascades within a single framework. Canonical strategic environments-such as the Prisoner's Dilemma, Stag Hunt, Chicken, and Harmony-are shown to correspond to open regions in payoff space, separated by low-codimension indifference boundaries across which equilibrium structure changes discontinuously. We formalize nudging as payoff engineering: minimal deterministic or stochastic perturbations designed to move a system across these boundaries. This perspective accommodates benevolent nudging, adversarial manipulation, linguistic reframing, and institutional design as instances of the same underlying operation. Extending the analysis to N-player settings, we show how threshold effects and strategic complementarities give rise to phase transitions and, dynamically, to self-organized criticality near coordination boundaries. Risk, noise, and variance are shown to matter only insofar as they deform incentive geometry, clarifying when stochastic interventions can and cannot alter strategic type. The framework yields concrete design principles for robustness and defensive engineering, emphasizing distance from critical boundaries, control of incentive gradients, and resistance to adversarial nudging. Incentive geometry thus provides a unifying lens for understanding robustness, escalation, and coordination across economic, institutional, and social systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个统一的激励几何理论框架，将博弈、助推、语言、市场结构和集体级联等现象纳入同一体系。通过将经典博弈环境映射到支付空间中的开放区域，揭示了均衡结构在不连续边界处的突变，并将助推形式化为跨越这些边界的支付工程。该框架为理解经济、制度和社会系统中的稳健性、升级和协调提供了统一视角。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个统一的几何理论框架来理解激励结构、战略环境变化以及干预措施（如助推、操纵、制度设计）对系统均衡的影响？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对博弈、助推、语言框架、市场结构和集体级联等现象的分析往往分散在不同领域，缺乏统一的数学框架。需要一种能够统一这些现象并揭示其内在联系的理论，以更好地理解激励结构如何影响战略互动和系统行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励几何理论：将战略环境映射到支付空间中的几何结构；将经典博弈（囚徒困境、猎鹿博弈、斗鸡博弈、和谐博弈）视为支付空间中的开放区域；引入低维无差异边界概念，均衡结构在这些边界处发生不连续变化；将助推形式化为支付工程（确定性和随机扰动）。
AI.method: 几何分析方法：将战略环境建模为支付空间中的几何结构；分析边界处的均衡突变；形式化助推作为跨越边界的扰动；扩展到N玩家设置，分析阈值效应和战略互补性；研究风险、噪声和方差如何扭曲激励几何。
AI.findings: 1. 经典博弈对应支付空间中的开放区域，由低维无差异边界分隔；2. 均衡结构在边界处发生不连续变化；3. 助推可视为跨越这些边界的支付工程；4. N玩家设置中阈值效应导致相变和自组织临界性；5. 风险、噪声和方差仅通过扭曲激励几何产生影响；6. 提出了稳健性和防御性工程的具体设计原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了统一的激励几何理论框架；2. 将多种战略现象纳入同一分析体系；3. 形式化了助推作为支付工程的概念；4. 揭示了均衡结构在几何边界处的不连续变化；5. 扩展了N玩家设置中的相变和临界性分析；6. 澄清了随机干预改变战略类型的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制度设计者提供了具体的稳健性设计原则；2. 强调与临界边界的距离、激励梯度的控制和对抗性助推的抵抗；3. 为政策制定者提供了理解干预措施效果的框架；4. 为组织设计和社会系统分析提供了实用工具；5. 有助于设计抗操纵和稳健的系统结构。

title: Food Inflation Passed Through from Agricultural Imports in a Small Open Economy
affiliations: Ohio State University (OSU) and

detail.title: Food Inflation Passed Through from Agricultural Imports in a Small Open Economy
detail.abstract: This paper develops a new framework for quantifying cost pass-through in a small open economy by estimating firm-level markup responses to agricultural import price shocks. We show theoretically that markup adjustments depend on firms' reliance on imported inputs and demand curvature, generating heterogeneous inflationary effects across firm types. For empirical implementation, we postulate a Leontief production structure, which expresses pass-through elasticity as a function of observed markup behavior and imported crop dependence. Using data on 10,911 South Korean food manufacturers from 2000 to 2021, we document considerable market power and increasing polarization in markups, particularly led by high-markup firms. Markup elasticities under strategic pricing decisions differ across sectors and firm types, with particularly stronger effects for non-large firms exhibiting low reliance on imported crops. Our firm-level pass-through measure reveals stable aggregate patterns over time but uncovers considerable heterogeneity - most notably, rising pass-through by firms less dependent on foreign crops. These findings illustrate how cost shocks propagate through strategic pricing and underscore the importance of firm heterogeneity in evaluating equilibrium pass-through.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个量化小型开放经济体中成本传导的新框架，通过估计企业层面标记对农业进口价格冲击的响应。研究发现标记调整取决于企业对进口投入品的依赖和需求曲率，导致不同企业类型的通胀效应异质性。实证分析显示韩国食品制造商存在显著市场力量和标记两极分化，成本传导在依赖进口作物较少的企业中更强。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的标记调整如何影响小型开放经济体中农业进口价格冲击的成本传导？
AI.motivation: 理解成本冲击如何通过企业战略定价行为传导至价格，以及企业异质性在均衡成本传导评估中的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业战略定价决策的理论框架，标记调整取决于企业对进口投入品的依赖程度和需求曲率，产生跨企业类型的异质性通胀效应。
AI.method: 采用里昂惕夫生产结构，将传导弹性表达为观测到的标记行为和进口作物依赖度的函数。使用2000-2021年韩国10,911家食品制造商的数据进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1) 韩国食品制造商存在显著市场力量和标记两极分化；2) 标记弹性在不同行业和企业类型中存在差异；3) 依赖进口作物较少的非大型企业传导效应更强；4) 企业层面传导存在显著异质性，但总体模式稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了量化小型开放经济体中成本传导的新理论框架，强调企业异质性和战略定价在成本冲击传导机制中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估成本冲击通胀效应的新工具，揭示了企业异质性对通胀传导的重要性，有助于更精准地制定贸易和竞争政策。

title: (Artificial) Intelligence Saturation and the Future of Work
affiliations: University of Pennsylvania and University of Pennsylvania - School of Social Policy & Practice

detail.title: (Artificial) Intelligence Saturation and the Future of Work

declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the Brookings Institution.

detail.abstract: Macroeconomic models typically treat AI as just another form of capital, and predict a slowly evolving world, while computer science scaling laws applied to the whole economy predict explosive growth and the potential for a singularity-like event. Both views gloss over the asymmetric reality that intelligence capital or AI scales at computer-science speeds, whereas physical capital and labor do not. What’s missing is a unified, parameter-driven framework that can nest assumptions from both economics and computer science to generate meaningful predictions of AI’s wage and output impacts. Here we use a constant elasticity of substitution (CES) production function framework that separates physical and intelligence sectors. Whereas physical capabilities let us affect the world, intelligence capabilities let us do this well: the two are complementary. Given complementarity between the two sectors, the marginal returns to intelligence saturate, no matter how fast AI scales. Because the price of AI capital is falling much faster than that of physical capital, intelligence tasks are automated first, pushing human labor toward the physical sector. The impact of automation on wages is theoretically ambiguous and can be non-monotonic in the degree of automation. A necessary condition for automation to decrease wages is that the share of employment in the intelligence sector decreases; this condition is not sufficient because automation can raise output enough to offset negative reallocation effects. In our baseline simulation, wages increase and then decrease with automation. Our interactive tool www.intelligencesaturation.org shows how parameter changes shift that trajectory. Wage decreases are steeper at high levels of automation when the outputs of the physical and intelligence sectors are more substitutable. After full automation, more AI and more physical capital increase wages, a classic prediction from standard production functions in capital and labor. Yet, when intelligence and physical are complementary, the marginal wage impact of AI capital saturates as AI grows large. More broadly, the model offers a structured way to map contrasting intuitions from economics and computer science into a shared parameter space, enabling clearer policy discussions, and guiding empirical work to identify which growth and wage trajectories are plausible.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个统一框架，将经济学和计算机科学对AI影响的两种对立观点结合起来。通过CES生产函数区分物理和智能部门，研究发现由于互补性，AI的边际回报会饱和，自动化对工资的影响是非单调的，工资可能先升后降。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个统一的参数驱动框架，既能容纳经济学和计算机科学对AI影响的不同假设，又能生成有意义的AI工资和产出影响预测？
AI.motivation: 现有宏观经济模型将AI视为普通资本，预测缓慢演变；而计算机科学规模定律应用于整个经济则预测爆炸性增长和奇点事件。两种观点都忽略了AI智能资本以计算机科学速度扩展，而物理资本和劳动力则不然的不对称现实。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用恒定替代弹性（CES）生产函数框架，将物理部门和智能部门分开。物理能力让我们影响世界，智能能力让我们做得更好，两者是互补的。
AI.method: 采用CES生产函数框架进行建模分析，通过区分物理和智能部门，分析AI资本价格下降速度远快于物理资本时的自动化过程，并进行基准模拟。
AI.findings: 1. 由于两个部门的互补性，无论AI扩展多快，智能的边际回报都会饱和；2. 自动化对工资的影响理论上是不明确的，可能是非单调的；3. 在基准模拟中，工资随自动化先增加后减少；4. 完全自动化后，更多AI和物理资本会增加工资；5. 当智能和物理互补时，AI资本的边际工资影响会随着AI增长而饱和。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了一个统一框架，将经济学和计算机科学对AI影响的对比直觉映射到共享参数空间；2. 解释了AI边际回报饱和的机制；3. 阐明了自动化对工资影响的非单调性；4. 为政策讨论提供了结构化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了交互式工具（www.intelligencesaturation.org）展示参数变化如何影响工资轨迹；2. 指导实证工作识别哪些增长和工资轨迹是合理的；3. 为政策制定者提供了更清晰的讨论框架。

title: Extracting Books from Production Language Models
affiliations: Stanford University, Yale University, Stanford University - Department of Computer Science and Stanford University

detail.title: Extracting Books from Production Language Models
detail.abstract: Many unresolved legal questions over LLMs and copyright center on memorization: whether specific training data have been encoded in the model's weights during training, and whether those memorized data can be extracted in the model's outputs. While many believe that LLMs do not memorize much of their training data, recent work shows that substantial amounts of copyrighted text can be extracted from open-weight models. However, it remains an open question if similar extraction is feasible for production LLMs, given the safety measures these systems implement. We investigate this question using a two-phase procedure: (1) an initial probe to test for extraction feasibility, which sometimes uses a Best-of-N (BoN) jailbreak, followed by (2) iterative continuation prompts to attempt to extract the book. We evaluate our procedure on four production LLMs--Claude 3.7 Sonnet, GPT-4.1, Gemini 2.5 Pro, and Grok 3--and we measure extraction success with a score computed from a block-based approximation of longest common substring (nv-recall). With different per-LLM experimental configurations, we were able to extract varying amounts of text. For the Phase 1 probe, it was unnecessary to jailbreak Gemini 2.5 Pro and Grok 3 to extract text (e.g, nv-recall of 76.8% and 70.3%, respectively, for Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone), while it was necessary for Claude 3.7 Sonnet and GPT-4.1. In some cases, jailbroken Claude 3.7 Sonnet outputs entire books near-verbatim (e.g., nv-recall = 95.8%). GPT-4.1 requires significantly more BoN attempts (e.g., 20×), and eventually refuses to continue (e.g., nv-recall = 4.0%). Taken together, our work highlights that, even with model-and system-level safeguards, extraction of (in-copyright) training data remains a risk for production LLMs. Disclosure: We ran experiments from mid-August to mid-September 2025, notified affected providers shortly after, and now make our findings public after a 90-day disclosure window.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过两阶段方法（初始探测+迭代续写）测试了四个商用LLM（Claude 3.7 Sonnet、GPT-4.1、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Grok 3）的训练数据提取可行性。研究发现即使有安全措施，仍能从这些模型中提取大量受版权保护的文本，其中Claude 3.7 Sonnet在越狱后可输出近原文的整本书（nv-recall达95.8%），而GPT-4.1需要更多尝试且最终会拒绝继续。
AI.research_question: 商用LLM（如Claude、GPT-4、Gemini、Grok）是否能够从其训练数据中提取受版权保护的文本内容，尽管这些系统实施了安全防护措施？
AI.motivation: 当前关于LLM与版权的法律争议核心在于记忆化问题：训练数据是否被编码到模型权重中，以及这些记忆的数据能否从模型输出中提取。虽然许多人认为LLM不会记忆太多训练数据，但近期研究表明开源模型可提取大量受版权文本。然而，对于实施了安全措施的商用LLM，类似的提取是否可行仍是一个开放性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: LLM记忆化理论、训练数据提取技术、模型安全防护机制、版权法律框架下的数据记忆与提取问题。
AI.method: 采用两阶段程序：1) 初始探测测试提取可行性（有时使用Best-of-N越狱技术）；2) 迭代续写提示尝试提取整本书。使用基于块的最长公共子串近似方法（nv-recall）计算提取成功率。在四个商用LLM上评估：Claude 3.7 Sonnet、GPT-4.1、Gemini 2.5 Pro、Grok 3。
AI.findings: 1) Gemini 2.5 Pro和Grok 3无需越狱即可提取文本（如《哈利·波特与魔法石》的nv-recall分别为76.8%和70.3%）；2) Claude 3.7 Sonnet和GPT-4.1需要越狱；3) 越狱后的Claude 3.7 Sonnet可输出近原文的整本书（nv-recall=95.8%）；4) GPT-4.1需要显著更多的BoN尝试（如20倍），且最终会拒绝继续（nv-recall=4.0%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了商用LLM即使有系统和模型级安全防护，仍存在训练数据提取风险；提供了针对生产环境LLM的记忆化实证研究；展示了不同商用LLM在抵抗训练数据提取方面的差异性和脆弱性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为LLM开发者提供了安全防护的评估基准；为版权法律争议提供了实证证据；提出了可复现的测试方法用于评估LLM的记忆化风险；促进了LLM安全社区的漏洞披露实践（90天披露窗口）。

title: State-Dependent Financial Market Responses to Balance Sheet Policy Announcements
affiliations: Clemson University and

detail.title: State-Dependent Financial Market Responses to Balance Sheet Policy Announcements
detail.abstract: We document state-dependent transmission of balance sheet policy announcements during the large-scale asset purchase era. Using announcement-day changes in the ten-year Treasury yield on scheduled FOMC dates as publicly replicable proxies for policy-related news over 2008Q1 to 2023Q4, we show three patterns. First, announcement-day yield responses are substantially weaker when federal debt service relative to revenue is elevated, with attenuation of approximately 60 percent in high debt-burden regimes. Second, interactions between announcement-day surprises and an expectations and uncertainty index operate primarily in low debt-service states and diminish as fiscal conditions deteriorate. Third, periods characterized by accommodative announcement-day yield movements are followed by medium-run declines in private fixed investment of approximately 2.7 percentage points over 12 to 14 quarters (95 percent CI:-4.3 to-0.8 percentage points), with this pattern aligning more closely with Treasury market functioning measures than with long-term yield movements. The results indicate economically meaningful nonlinearities in announcement-day transmission that are robust across fiscal measures and market functioning proxies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2008-2023年间美联储资产负债表政策公告的传导效应如何随财政状况变化。研究发现，当联邦债务负担较重时，政策公告对国债收益率的冲击减弱约60%；政策不确定性效应主要在低债务负担时显著；宽松政策公告后私人固定资产投资会下降约2.7个百分点。
AI.research_question: 美联储资产负债表政策公告的传导效应如何随财政状况（特别是债务负担）而变化？政策公告对金融市场和实体经济的冲击是否存在状态依赖性？
AI.motivation: 传统货币政策传导研究通常假设政策效应是线性的，但实际中财政状况可能影响政策有效性。特别是在大规模资产购买时代，理解政策传导如何受财政约束影响对政策制定至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于状态依赖的货币政策传导理论，结合财政主导理论框架，探讨财政约束如何影响货币政策有效性。关注债务负担与政策不确定性交互作用对传导机制的影响。
AI.method: 使用2008Q1-2023Q4期间FOMC会议日的10年期国债收益率变化作为政策新闻代理变量。采用状态依赖回归分析，区分高/低债务负担状态，并检验政策不确定性指数的调节作用。使用事件研究法和中期效应分析。
AI.findings: 1. 当联邦债务负担较重时，政策公告对收益率的冲击减弱约60%；2. 政策不确定性效应主要在低债务负担时显著，随财政状况恶化而减弱；3. 宽松政策公告后12-14个季度内私人固定资产投资下降约2.7个百分点；4. 这些效应与国债市场功能指标关联更紧密而非长期收益率变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了货币政策传导状态依赖性的实证证据；2. 揭示了财政约束如何影响政策有效性；3. 拓展了财政-货币政策交互作用的理论框架；4. 强调了市场功能在传导机制中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了考虑财政状况的政策设计依据；2. 帮助市场参与者理解不同财政环境下政策传导差异；3. 为评估政策效果提供了更精细的分析框架；4. 对危机时期政策制定具有重要参考价值。

title: Artificial Intelligence and Academic Cheating: A Stag Hunt for Faculty and Students
affiliations: University of Washington - The Information School

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence and Academic Cheating: A Stag Hunt for Faculty and Students
detail.abstract: The rapid diffusion of generative AI has transformed academic misconduct into an assurance or stag hunt game between faculty and students. .. destabilizing the cooperative norms upon which higher education depends. After surveying the scope of contemporary cheating by both students and professors, I examine stag hunt AI-cheating under mutual expectations of opacity. Because neither party can reliably detect the other's AI use, each is incentivized to "hunt hare" (pursue time savings via AI) rather than "hunt stag" (invest in authentic teaching and learning). I then outline institutional remedies designed to reintroduce assurance through observability. Absent such reforms, the "fool's prize" of saved time erodes human capacity formation and devalues the degree signal, threatening the viability of the contemporary university. Cheating has always been a problem in higher education. Students and professors plagiarize, fabricate data, set up citation mills, run fake conferences with fake conference proceedings, and even misrepresent information on applications or curriculum viteas. 1 * The basic idea for this article was informally discussed at. .. Thanks to. . and the other conference participants for their comments about game theory, the prisoner's dilemma, and AI cheating.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨生成式AI如何将学术不端行为转变为师生间的"保证博弈"或"猎鹿博弈"。由于双方都无法可靠检测对方的AI使用，导致都倾向于选择"猎兔"（通过AI节省时间）而非"猎鹿"（投资于真实教学与学习），从而破坏高等教育赖以生存的合作规范。作者提出通过可观察性重新引入保证机制的制度性补救措施。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何改变高等教育中学术不端行为的博弈动态？在相互不透明的预期下，师生间的AI作弊行为如何形成"猎鹿博弈"困境？需要什么样的制度性改革来重建合作规范？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI的快速扩散正在从根本上改变学术不端行为的性质，将传统的作弊问题转变为师生间的战略博弈。这种转变威胁到高等教育赖以生存的合作规范，可能侵蚀人力资本形成并贬低学位信号的价值，从而危及当代大学的存续。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文主要运用博弈论框架，特别是"保证博弈"（Assurance Game）和"猎鹿博弈"（Stag Hunt Game）理论。这些理论用于分析在相互不透明条件下，师生双方因无法可靠检测对方AI使用而产生的战略互动困境。
AI.method: 作者采用理论分析方法：1）调查当代学生和教授的作弊范围；2）在相互不透明的预期下分析AI作弊的猎鹿博弈动态；3）通过博弈论框架推导制度性解决方案。
AI.findings: 研究发现：在相互不透明的条件下，师生双方都倾向于选择"猎兔"策略（使用AI节省时间），而非"猎鹿"策略（投资真实教学与学习）。这种均衡导致合作规范被破坏，形成"傻瓜的奖赏"——节省时间却侵蚀人力资本形成并贬低学位信号价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）将生成式AI背景下的学术不端行为概念化为保证博弈/猎鹿博弈；2）阐明了相互不透明性如何改变高等教育中的战略互动；3）为理解AI时代的教育质量保证问题提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）识别了AI时代高等教育面临的新风险；2）提出了通过可观察性重新引入保证机制的制度性改革方案；3）为教育机构应对AI作弊提供了战略指导，强调需要建立透明度和信任机制来维持教育质量。

title: Public Funds, Private Coverage: The Political Returns to Media Capture

detail.title: Public Funds, Private Coverage: The Political Returns to Media Capture
detail.abstract: This paper provides novel evidence on the prevalence and downstream consequences of public media capture in a Western democracy. Discretionary advertisement spending by Austrian ministries increases both the quantity and positivity of newspaper coverage about corresponding ministers. These effects arise immediately, persist beyond ideological alignment between politicians and media outlets, and are stronger when newspapers are more reliant on public funds. Using high-frequency panel data on households' media exposure, I quantify the political returns to media capture. Media capture substantially yet asymmetrically influences citizens' voting intentions, consolidating support among the electoral base while provoking backlash from opponents, thereby amplifying polarization.

AI.tldr: 奥地利政府通过部门广告支出影响媒体报道，媒体俘获在西方民主国家普遍存在，对选民投票意向产生显著但不对称的影响，加剧政治极化。
AI.research_question: 西方民主国家中公共媒体俘获的普遍性及其下游后果是什么？具体而言，政府广告支出如何影响媒体报道，进而影响公民投票意向？
AI.motivation: 虽然媒体俘获现象在威权国家已有研究，但在西方民主国家中的存在和影响尚未得到充分验证。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究政府通过广告支出影响媒体报道的机制及其政治后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 媒体俘获理论、政治经济学、议程设置理论、政治极化理论
AI.method: 使用奥地利政府部门广告支出与报纸报道的高频面板数据，分析广告支出对报道数量与正面性的影响；结合家庭媒体暴露数据，量化媒体俘获对投票意向的影响。
AI.findings: 政府广告支出显著增加相关部长的报道数量和正面性；这种影响立即出现，超越意识形态对齐，且在报纸更依赖公共资金时更强；媒体俘获对投票意向产生不对称影响：巩固选民基础支持，同时引发反对者反弹，加剧政治极化。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在西方民主国家实证验证媒体俘获现象；提出媒体俘获对政治极化的不对称影响机制；扩展了媒体俘获理论在民主政体中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于政府广告支出政治影响的警示；为媒体监管提供实证依据；帮助公民理解媒体报道可能存在的偏见来源。

title: Stuck in the Middle: Revisiting the Farm Size-Productivity Puzzle

detail.title: Stuck in the Middle: Revisiting the Farm Size-Productivity Puzzle

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any funding

detail.abstract: This paper revisits the farm size-productivity relationship through a dynamic model of endogenous technology choice under land heterogeneity and market imperfections. Farmers select between a traditional labor-intensive and a modern capital-intensive technology, each shaped by supervision costs, family labor constraints, and irreversible investment. The model generates a non-monotonic productivity-land profile, an endogenous adoption threshold, and potential for dual steady states. We show that structural features, not just static inefficiencies, can trap farms in suboptimal regimes, even under favorable price conditions. Theoretical results yield testable implications for threshold estimation, technology adoption dynamics, and the long-run impact of capital subsidies. These findings offer a unified explanation for the persistence of smallholder systems in some settings and their disappearance in others.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一个考虑土地异质性和市场不完美的内生技术选择动态模型，重新审视了农场规模与生产率的关系。研究发现，结构性特征（不仅仅是静态低效率）可能导致农场陷入次优状态，即使在有利的价格条件下也是如此。
AI.research_question: 农场规模与生产率之间的关系如何受到内生技术选择、土地异质性和市场不完美的影响？结构性特征如何导致农场陷入次优状态？
AI.motivation: 重新审视农场规模与生产率的关系，理解为什么在某些环境下小农系统持续存在，而在其他环境下却消失，探索结构性特征（不仅仅是静态低效率）对农场技术选择和长期发展的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生技术选择动态模型，考虑土地异质性、市场不完美、监督成本、家庭劳动力约束和不可逆投资。农民在传统劳动密集型技术和现代资本密集型技术之间进行选择。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建动态模型分析农场技术选择、生产率与土地规模的关系，推导出非单调的生产率-土地剖面、内生采用阈值和可能的双重稳态。
AI.findings: 模型产生了非单调的生产率-土地剖面，内生采用阈值，以及可能的双重稳态。结构性特征（不仅仅是静态低效率）可能导致农场陷入次优状态，即使在有利的价格条件下也是如此。
AI.theory_contributions: 为农场规模与生产率关系提供了统一的理论解释，解释了小农系统在某些环境下持续存在而在其他环境下消失的现象。提出了可检验的阈值估计、技术采用动态和资本补贴长期影响的理论预测。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于资本补贴长期影响的见解，帮助理解技术采用动态和农场发展路径，为农业发展和扶贫政策提供理论依据。

title: Beyond Linear Disclosures: Deciphering Corporate Credit Risk through Information Geometry and Dynamic Topic Modeling

detail.title: Beyond Linear Disclosures: Deciphering Corporate Credit Risk through Information Geometry and Dynamic Topic Modeling
detail.abstract: This study introduces a novel framework for predicting corporate credit risk by analyzing the evolution of narrative disclosures in S&P 500 SEC filings from 2005 to 2023. Utilizing Dynamic Topic Modeling (DTM), we extract latent thematic trajectories from Management's Discussion and Analysis (Item 7) and Market Risk Disclosures (Item 7A), capturing how executive discourse shifts across multiple economic cycles. To address the non-linear nature of these textual latents, we employ Information Geometry, specifically using Symmetric Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence and Fisher-Rao metrics to map firms onto a Riemannian manifold. Our empirical results demonstrate that approximately 4% to 13% of the informational variance in corporate disclosures is lost when using standard linear metrics. Through a Quantile Regression (𝑞 = 0.9) to the geometric manifold, we identify "Geometric Component 2" as a highly significant leading indicator of financial distress (𝑝 < 0.0001), even when traditional financial metrics appear stable. Deconstructing this "Risk Manifold" reveals that specific thematic shifts toward credit portfolio vulnerabilities and liquidity constraints (Topic 10), alongside regulatory exposures (Topic 7), serve as quantitative precursors to default events. These findings suggest that the geometric orientation of corporate narratives contains critical, non-redundant information, providing institutional investors and risk managers with an enhanced early-warning signal for credit risk assessment.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种通过分析S&P 500公司SEC文件中叙事披露演变来预测企业信用风险的新框架。使用动态主题建模提取管理层讨论和市场风险披露中的潜在主题轨迹，并采用信息几何学方法（对称KL散度和Fisher-Rao度量）将公司映射到黎曼流形上。研究发现，使用标准线性度量会损失约4%-13%的信息方差，而几何流形中的"几何成分2"是财务困境的显著领先指标，特定主题转变（信贷组合脆弱性和监管暴露）可作为违约事件的定量前兆。
AI.research_question: 企业叙事披露的几何结构如何提供传统财务指标之外的信用风险预测信息？
AI.motivation: 传统信用风险评估主要依赖财务指标，但这些指标往往滞后且无法捕捉管理层叙事中的微妙变化。企业SEC文件中的叙事披露包含大量未被充分利用的信息，特别是在经济周期变化中，管理层的语言和主题演变可能预示着未来的财务困境。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 动态主题建模（DTM）：用于从文本数据中提取随时间演变的潜在主题
2. 信息几何学：特别是对称Kullback-Leibler散度和Fisher-Rao度量，用于在黎曼流形上表示公司
3. 几何数据分析：将非线性文本潜在变量映射到几何空间进行分析
AI.method:
1. 数据：2005-2023年S&P 500公司的SEC文件（Item 7和Item 7A）
2. 文本分析：使用动态主题建模提取叙事主题轨迹
3. 几何建模：应用信息几何学方法将公司映射到黎曼流形
4. 统计分析：使用分位数回归（q=0.9）分析几何流形与信用风险的关系
5. 实证检验：验证几何成分作为财务困境领先指标的预测能力
AI.findings:
1. 标准线性度量会损失约4%-13%的叙事信息方差
2. "几何成分2"是财务困境的显著领先指标（p<0.0001），即使在传统财务指标稳定时也有效
3. 特定主题转变（Topic 10：信贷组合脆弱性和流动性约束；Topic 7：监管暴露）是违约事件的定量前兆
4. 企业叙事的几何方向包含关键的非冗余信息
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将信息几何学引入企业文本分析领域，提供非线性文本数据处理的新方法
2. 提出"风险流形"概念，将企业叙事映射到几何空间进行分析
3. 证明叙事披露的几何结构包含传统财务分析无法捕捉的预测信息
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为机构投资者和风险管理者提供增强的信用风险早期预警信号
2. 开发了基于企业叙事几何分析的实际风险评估工具
3. 帮助投资者在传统财务指标稳定时识别潜在的信用风险

title: The Golden Age of Racial Surveillance
affiliations: University of Johannesburg

detail.title: The Golden Age of Racial Surveillance
detail.abstract:
We are living in times of deep turmoil and rapid change. Computers, wired together across the internet, have drastically expanded the capacity to spy on and assess individuals, groups, and populations. Surveillance has long been used a tool for the oppression and control of those being watched. As Noam Chomsky puts it, surveillance technology can be used “for making money, and you can use it for controlling people’s attitudes and beliefs, directing them toward what you want them to do.” Throughout modern history, surveillance has been developed and used by racially dominant groups to direct them toward “what they want them to do,” most often for the purpose of exploitation and profit.

This chapter, published in the Cambridge Handbook of Race and Surveillance (2023), chronicles how surveillance (re)produces racial inequality. Covering a wide range of topics and global histories, it provides a snapshot of how governments and corporations exploit technology to surveil and punish racially oppressed groups. The chapter concludes with an overview of the remaining fifteen chapters in the edited volume.

AI.tldr: 本章节探讨了监控技术如何（再）生产种族不平等，分析了政府和公司如何利用技术监控和惩罚种族受压迫群体，并概述了《剑桥种族与监控手册》中其他章节的内容。
AI.research_question: 监控技术如何（再）生产种族不平等？政府和公司如何利用技术监控和惩罚种族受压迫群体？
AI.motivation: 在深度动荡和快速变化的时代，互联网连接的计算机极大地扩展了对个人、群体和人口的监控能力。监控长期以来被用作压迫和控制被监视者的工具，历史上被种族优势群体用于剥削和牟利。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判种族理论、监控研究、技术社会学、后殖民理论，引用Noam Chomsky关于监控技术用于牟利和控制人们态度信念的观点。
AI.method: 历史分析、文献综述、案例研究，涵盖广泛主题和全球历史，提供政府和企业利用技术监控种族受压迫群体的概览。
AI.findings: 监控技术被政府和公司系统性地用于监控和惩罚种族受压迫群体，这种监控实践（再）生产了种族不平等，成为现代种族压迫的重要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了种族与监控交叉的理论框架，阐明了监控技术如何成为种族压迫的工具，为理解技术、权力和种族不平等的关系提供了理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了监控技术对种族受压迫群体的实际影响，为政策制定者、活动家和学者提供了理解监控种族维度的实践参考，有助于推动更公平的技术治理。

title: Common Ownership and Collaborative R&D Networks
affiliations: George Washington University - Department of Economics, Virginia Tech and

detail.title: Common Ownership and Collaborative R&D Networks
detail.abstract: Networks of bilateral R&D collaborative links have been observed to display core-periphery architectures. In the received literature, predicated on single ownership of firms, core-periphery architectures arise only when there are indirect benefits from R&D links. In their absence, R&D networks consist of a dominant group of mutually interlinked firms while other firms remain isolated. Empirical evidence, however, points to common (cross or overlapping) ownership of firms. We show that common ownership of firms can generate core-periphery architectures even when there are only direct benefits from R&D links. We also compare R&D networks under local monopoly exhibiting positive externalities with Cournot competition exhibiting negative externalities.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了双边研发合作网络中的核心-边缘架构形成机制。传统理论认为，只有在存在间接利益时才会出现这种架构，但实证显示企业共同所有权普遍存在。研究发现，即使只有直接利益，共同所有权也能产生核心-边缘架构，并比较了不同市场结构下的网络形态。
AI.research_question: 企业共同所有权如何影响双边研发合作网络的结构形成？特别是在只有直接利益的情况下，共同所有权是否能解释观察到的核心-边缘架构？
AI.motivation: 实证观察显示研发合作网络常呈现核心-边缘架构，但传统理论基于单一所有权假设，认为只有在间接利益存在时才会出现这种结构。然而现实中企业共同所有权普遍存在，这促使研究者重新审视网络形成的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于双边研发合作网络理论、核心-边缘网络架构理论、企业共同所有权理论，以及不同市场结构（本地垄断与古诺竞争）下的外部性分析框架。
AI.method: 理论建模分析，比较不同所有权结构（单一所有权vs共同所有权）和不同市场结构（本地垄断与古诺竞争）下的研发网络均衡形成机制。
AI.findings: 1. 共同所有权可以在只有直接利益的情况下产生核心-边缘架构；2. 在本地垄断（正外部性）和古诺竞争（负外部性）两种市场结构下，研发网络形态存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了研发合作网络形成理论，引入共同所有权作为核心解释机制；2. 挑战了传统单一所有权假设下的网络形成理论；3. 建立了不同市场结构下网络形态的比较分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解企业研发合作模式提供新视角；2. 帮助企业管理者在共同所有权背景下优化研发合作策略；3. 为反垄断机构评估研发合作网络提供理论依据。

title: Local Political Uncertainty and Branch Banking: Evidence from Deposit Rate Setting
affiliations: University College Dublin, University College Dublin (UCD) and University College Dublin (UCD) - Michael Smurfit Graduate Business School

detail.title: Local Political Uncertainty and Branch Banking: Evidence from Deposit Rate Setting
detail.abstract: Using upcoming gubernatorial elections in the U.S. as a source of variation in local political uncertainty, we examine how bank branches—key players in local credit markets—adjust deposit interest rates and, subsequently, local deposit funding and the supply of local credit in response. We find that branches facing heightened uncertainty ahead of gubernatorial elections tend to raise deposit rates, which gradually return to normal levels after the elections. This adjustment is accompanied by an increase in deposit volumes prior to the elections, but does not translate into growth in mortgages and small business lending, consistent with a stronger motive for liquidity hoarding under political uncertainty. In contrast, branches in states without gubernatorial elections—whose parent banks are headquartered in states holding elections—are more likely to lower deposit rates, possibly reflecting efforts to manage funding costs at the bank level. By isolating the effects of political uncertainty at both the branch and headquarters levels, our study highlights that uncertainty at each level plays a critical role in shaping branch-level deposit pricing.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用美国州长选举作为政治不确定性的自然实验，发现银行分行在选举前会提高存款利率以吸引资金，但并未将增加的资金用于扩大本地信贷，而是倾向于囤积流动性。同时，总部位于选举州的银行会降低非选举州分行的存款利率以控制整体资金成本。
AI.research_question: 政治不确定性如何影响银行分行的存款利率定价、存款资金流动以及本地信贷供给？
AI.motivation: 政治不确定性对经济活动有重要影响，但具体如何影响银行这一关键金融中介的决策，特别是在分行层面的存款定价和信贷供给方面，尚缺乏深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性理论、银行流动性管理理论和信贷供给理论，研究政治不确定性对银行决策的影响机制。
AI.method: 利用美国州长选举作为政治不确定性的外生冲击，采用双重差分法（DID）分析选举前后银行分行存款利率、存款量和信贷供给的变化。
AI.findings: 1. 面临选举不确定性的分行会提高存款利率，选举后逐渐恢复正常；2. 存款量在选举前增加；3. 但增加的存款并未转化为抵押贷款和小企业贷款的增长；4. 总部在选举州的银行会降低非选举州分行的存款利率。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了政治不确定性在分行和总部两个层面对银行决策的不同影响机制；2. 提供了银行在不确定性下流动性囤积行为的实证证据；3. 丰富了不确定性对金融中介行为影响的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行管理者在政治不确定性时期的资金管理提供决策参考；2. 为监管机构理解银行信贷供给波动提供依据；3. 帮助企业和居民理解政治事件对信贷可获得性的影响。

title: Collaborative R&D Networks with Incomplete Information
affiliations: George Washington University - Department of Economics, Virginia Tech and

detail.title: Collaborative R&D Networks with Incomplete Information
detail.abstract: This paper examines the incentives of heterogeneous firms to form R&D networks when firms have private information regarding their productivity and limited information regarding the architecture of the R&D network. We characterize equilibrium networks and contrast it with those that emerge when firms' productivities are publicly known and the R&D network is perfectly observable. We provide a theoretical underpinning for the empirically observed core-periphery networks and show that these could arise in equilibrium even if there are no indirect benefits from links. Interestingly, low and intermediate productivity firms form the core and high productivity firms the periphery. Further, intermediate productivity firms serve as "structural bridges" to connect low and high productivity firms. Finally, we show that equilibrium networks are typically inefficient.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当企业拥有关于生产率的私有信息且对研发网络结构信息有限时，异质企业形成研发网络的激励。研究发现核心-边缘网络在均衡中出现，低和中生产率企业构成核心，高生产率企业处于边缘，中间生产率企业充当连接低高生产率企业的"结构桥梁"。
AI.research_question: 当企业拥有生产率私有信息且对研发网络结构信息有限时，异质企业如何形成研发网络？均衡网络结构是什么？与完全信息情况有何不同？
AI.motivation: 现实中企业通常拥有关于自身生产率的私有信息，且对研发网络结构的信息有限。现有研究多假设完全信息，需要研究不完全信息下企业形成研发网络的激励和均衡网络结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络形成理论、博弈论、不完全信息理论、企业异质性理论、核心-边缘网络理论
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建不完全信息下的网络形成博弈模型，分析均衡网络结构，并与完全信息情况进行对比分析
AI.findings: 1. 核心-边缘网络在均衡中出现，即使没有间接链接收益；2. 低和中生产率企业构成核心，高生产率企业处于边缘；3. 中间生产率企业充当连接低高生产率企业的"结构桥梁"；4. 均衡网络通常是无效率的
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为实证观察到的核心-边缘网络提供理论解释；2. 扩展了不完全信息下的网络形成理论；3. 揭示了企业异质性与网络结构的关系；4. 提出了"结构桥梁"的新概念
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助企业理解在不完全信息下如何形成研发网络；2. 为政策制定者设计促进研发合作的机制提供参考；3. 解释了现实中观察到的研发网络结构特征

title: Urban Collapse as a Coordination Failure: Threshold Dynamics, Welfare Loss, and Policy Stabilization

detail.title: Urban Collapse as a Coordination Failure: Threshold Dynamics, Welfare Loss, and Policy Stabilization
detail.abstract: Cities concentrate productivity, innovation, and opportunity, yet many appear to decline suddenly rather than gradually. This paper develops a dynamic model in which urban decline can arise not only from deteriorating fundamentals, but also from coordination failures driven by population-dependent externalities. Individuals decide whether to live in the city based on wages, amenities, and housing costs, while aggregate productivity depends on the scale of complementary economic activity. A social planner internalizes these spillovers, while decentralized agents do not. The interaction between cross-sector complementarities and congestion costs generates multiple equilibria: a low-population collapse state and a high-population prosperity state, separated by an unstable threshold. We characterize the planner's problem, show that decentralized equilibria can be inefficiently small, and demonstrate that collapse can occur even when the city remains socially valuable. The analysis studies policy instruments such as temporary subsidies, guarantees, and minimum population commitments, and derives conditions under which modest, time-limited support can eliminate the inefficient equilibrium by coordinating expectations rather than permanently altering fundamentals. Extensions demonstrate robustness to multisector networks, remote-work shocks, anchor firms, and endogenous housing supply. Overall, the framework provides a tractable lens for understanding urban fragility, recovery, and coordinated investment, while clarifying when stabilization is feasible and when it may fail.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个动态城市模型，解释城市为何会突然而非逐渐衰退。模型显示，除了基本面恶化外，人口依赖的外部性导致的协调失败也会引发城市衰退。模型存在多重均衡：低人口的崩溃状态和高人口的繁荣状态。研究表明，适度的临时性政策干预可以协调预期，消除低效均衡。
AI.research_question: 城市为何会突然衰退而非逐渐衰退？除了基本面恶化外，协调失败如何导致城市衰退？政策干预如何通过协调预期而非永久改变基本面来防止城市衰退？
AI.motivation: 城市集中了生产力、创新和机会，但许多城市似乎会突然衰退而非逐渐衰退。现有研究主要关注基本面因素，但协调失败可能也是重要原因。理解城市衰退的机制对于制定有效的城市政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人口依赖的外部性、跨部门互补性和拥堵成本的动态城市模型。结合了集聚经济、协调博弈和多重均衡理论。社会规划者内部化溢出效应，而分散化个体则不会。
AI.method: 理论建模方法：开发动态模型，个体基于工资、便利设施和住房成本决定是否居住在城市，而总生产力取决于互补经济活动的规模。分析社会规划者问题与分散化均衡的比较。研究政策工具如临时补贴、担保和最低人口承诺。
AI.findings: 1. 跨部门互补性与拥堵成本的相互作用产生多重均衡：低人口崩溃状态和高人口繁荣状态，中间有不稳定阈值。2. 分散化均衡可能效率低下（城市规模过小）。3. 即使城市仍有社会价值，崩溃仍可能发生。4. 适度的、有时间限制的支持可以通过协调预期而非永久改变基本面来消除低效均衡。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了一个理解城市脆弱性和恢复的易处理框架。2. 阐明了协调失败如何导致城市突然衰退。3. 扩展了多重均衡理论在城市经济学中的应用。4. 展示了政策干预通过协调预期而非改变基本面的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解城市衰退和复苏的分析工具。2. 阐明了何时稳定政策可行，何时可能失败。3. 提出了具体的政策工具：临时补贴、担保、最低人口承诺。4. 为协调投资决策提供了理论指导。5. 模型扩展考虑了多部门网络、远程工作冲击、锚定企业和内生住房供给的现实因素。

title: Designing Carbon Sequestering Programs for Farmers: Economic Incentives and Environmental Impacts
affiliations: Nova School of Business and Economics and USC Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Designing Carbon Sequestering Programs for Farmers: Economic Incentives and Environmental Impacts
detail.abstract: Problem definition: Agricultural carbon programs aim to incentivize smallholder farmers to adopt soil-health practices that sequester carbon and generate verifiable credits. However, their effectiveness in delivering additional carbon sequestration depends on how platforms set commissions and how regulators set audit intensity to verify additionality claims. Then, how do these policy and platform levers, through their interaction with farmers' strategic adoption timing and commodity-price feedback, influence measured additionality, total carbon captured, and farmers' economic outcomes? Methodology/results: We develop a two-period game-theoretic model in which farmers choose whether and when to adopt soil-health practices, a platform sets commissions to incentivize adoption, and a regulator selects audit intensity to verify the additionality of credited carbon. We compare (i) uniform commissions, in which all adopters are paid a uniform commission, and (ii) differentiated commissions, in which the platform tailors the commission to farmers' adoption history. Our results suggest that while carbon programs increase sequestered carbon, they can reduce aggregate farmer profit via negative spillovers in commodity markets. Further, stricter audits can backfire: they raise measured additionality yet delay adoption, lowering farmer welfare and total sequestration. Across commission designs, the differentiated policy leads to higher measured additionality, whereas the uniform policy delivers greater total carbon sequestration, with relative welfare performance depending on the strength of commodity-market spillovers. A calibration using Indian maize data maps the parameter regions where objectives align and yields prescriptive insights for policymakers. Managerial Implications: Although often presented as 'win-win' for the environment and farmers, our results indicate that agricultural carbon programs may fall short of intended outcomes when audits, commissions, and market feedback are misaligned with farmers' strategic incentives. While these programs consistently increase total carbon captured compared to the benchmark, they may reduce farmer profits if these levers are not chosen carefully. Recognizing this strategic interplay is therefore essential for designing credible, scalable, and welfare-enhancing carbon markets in agriculture.

AI.tldr: 农业碳项目通过激励小农采用固碳实践，但有效性受平台佣金和监管审计强度影响。研究发现碳项目增加固碳量，但可能通过商品市场负溢出降低农民总利润。严格审计可能适得其反：提高测量额外性但延迟采用，降低农民福利和总固碳量。差异化佣金政策提高测量额外性，统一佣金政策带来更大总固碳量。
AI.research_question: 政策和平台杠杆（佣金设置和审计强度）如何通过与农民战略采用时机和商品价格反馈的相互作用，影响测量的额外性、总碳捕获量和农民经济结果？
AI.motivation: 农业碳项目旨在激励小农采用土壤健康实践以固碳并产生可验证信用，但其在提供额外碳封存方面的有效性取决于平台佣金设置和监管审计强度，需要研究这些政策工具如何影响项目效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型，包含农民采用决策、平台佣金设置和监管审计强度的战略互动，考虑商品市场价格反馈效应和农民采用时机选择。
AI.method: 开发两期博弈论模型，农民选择是否及何时采用土壤健康实践，平台设置佣金激励采用，监管选择审计强度验证碳信用额外性。比较统一佣金和差异化佣金两种政策设计，使用印度玉米数据进行校准。
AI.findings: 1) 碳项目增加固碳量但可能通过商品市场负溢出降低农民总利润；2) 严格审计可能适得其反：提高测量额外性但延迟采用，降低农民福利和总固碳量；3) 差异化佣金政策带来更高测量额外性，统一佣金政策带来更大总固碳量；4) 相对福利表现取决于商品市场溢出强度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 建立农业碳市场中农民战略采用时机、平台佣金设计和监管审计强度的综合博弈模型；2) 揭示严格审计可能产生意外负面后果的理论机制；3) 比较不同佣金设计对测量额外性和总固碳量的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供设计农业碳市场的实用指导；2) 识别参数区域以实现环境目标和农民福利的协调；3) 强调需要谨慎选择审计强度和佣金设计以避免减少农民利润；4) 提供基于印度玉米数据的校准结果和处方性见解。

title: The First 1000 Days and Beyond: The Process of Child Development
affiliations: Yale University

detail.title: The First 1000 Days and Beyond: The Process of Child Development
detail.abstract:
This paper reviews recent developments in the economics of human development, focusing on the early years of life as a critical period for shaping long-term outcomes. Early childhood development is inherently multidimensional: cognitive and socioemotional skills evolve dynamically and interact with health, nutrition, and environmental influences. Economists have contributed to this field by providing a conceptual unifying framework that highlights how key drivers of development reflect the choices of individuals operating under incentives and constraints. Within this framework, the paper emphasizes two central challenges: understanding the interactions among multiple dimensions of development and identifying causal links - particularly the effects of different inputs at different ages. Measurement issues are a recurring theme, given the difficulty of assessing young children and the need for comparability across contexts. The paper also stresses these issues’ policy relevance for poverty reduction and social mobility by discussing early childhood interventions in both developed and developing countries.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了人类发展经济学的最新进展，聚焦于生命早期作为塑造长期结果的关键时期。早期儿童发展本质上是多维度的：认知和社会情感技能动态演化，并与健康、营养和环境因素相互作用。经济学家通过提供一个概念统一框架来贡献这一领域，该框架强调发展的关键驱动因素如何反映个体在激励和约束下的选择。论文强调两个核心挑战：理解发展多个维度间的相互作用，以及识别因果联系——特别是不同年龄阶段不同投入的影响。测量问题是一个反复出现的主题，考虑到评估幼儿的困难以及跨情境可比性的需求。论文还通过讨论发达国家和发展中国家的早期儿童干预措施，强调了这些问题对减贫和社会流动的政策相关性。
AI.research_question: 早期儿童发展如何影响长期社会经济结果？在激励和约束下，个体选择如何塑造人类发展的关键驱动因素？如何理解发展多个维度间的相互作用并识别不同年龄阶段不同投入的因果效应？
AI.motivation: 早期儿童发展对长期社会经济结果具有深远影响，但这一过程是多维、动态且复杂的。经济学家需要提供一个统一框架来理解个体在激励和约束下的选择如何塑造发展轨迹，同时解决测量和因果识别等关键挑战，为减贫和社会流动政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济学的人类发展框架：强调个体在激励和约束下的选择如何影响发展轨迹；多维发展理论：认知、社会情感、健康、营养和环境因素的动态相互作用；生命历程理论：早期发展对长期结果的持久影响；因果推断框架：识别不同年龄阶段不同投入的因果效应。
AI.method: 文献综述方法：系统回顾人类发展经济学领域的最新研究；概念框架构建：提供统一的经济学分析框架；跨情境比较分析：对比发达国家和发展中国家的早期干预措施；测量方法评估：分析评估幼儿发展的各种测量工具和方法。
AI.findings: 早期儿童发展是多维且动态的过程，各维度间存在复杂的相互作用；个体选择在激励和约束下显著影响发展轨迹；不同年龄阶段的投入具有不同的因果效应；测量问题是该领域的关键挑战；早期干预措施对减贫和社会流动具有重要政策意义。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个统一的经济学框架来分析人类发展；阐明了激励和约束下个体选择在发展过程中的作用；深化了对多维发展动态相互作用的理解；推进了早期发展因果效应的识别方法；丰富了生命历程经济学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为早期儿童干预政策提供了经济学依据；强调了测量标准化和可比性的重要性；为减贫和社会流动政策提供了实证支持；为发达国家和发展中国家的政策制定者提供了实践指导；促进了跨学科的人类发展研究和政策对话。

title: Nomination Nobel Peace Prize 2026 Human Resources, Digital Systems, and Robotic Warfare in Indonesia's Space Agency SDGs, Ethics, and Global Security Implications
affiliations: , President Republik Indonesia, Ministry of Primary and Secondary Education, Universitas Borobudur Jakarta and Kementerian Sosial RI (Indonesian Ministry of Social Affairs)

detail.title: Nomination Nobel Peace Prize 2026 Human Resources, Digital Systems, and Robotic Warfare in Indonesia's Space Agency SDGs, Ethics, and Global Security Implications

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The nominee, Prof. Dr. Dian Damayanti, affirms that there are no personal or financial relationships that could be perceived as compromising the integrity, independence, or impartiality of the work underpinning this Nobel Peace Prize nomination. Dr. Damayanti’s research and advocacy have been supported through academic collaborations, multilateral forums, and institutional partnerships aligned with the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). These engagements include participation in ASEAN policy dialogues, contributions to international conferences, and cooperative projects with educational and research institutions. None of these collaborations have influenced the objectivity of her scholarship or the peace-oriented outcomes presented in this nomination. The nominee declares full responsibility for the originality, ethical grounding, and global relevance of the contributions recognized herein.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve clinical trials or medical interventions. All qualitative research activities, including interviews, case studies, and stakeholder consultations, were conducted in accordance with internationally recognized ethical standards. Where applicable, written informed consent was obtained from participants prior to their involvement.
